Senior Staff AI Scientist
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 We are looking for an exceptional Sr Staff AI Scientist with a strong research background and deep expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI. This role is ideal for a highly analytical and innovation\-driven professional who can lead advanced AI research, design production\-grade intelligent systems, and translate emerging AI capabilities into real business impact.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will hold a PhD or Masters in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, with proven experience in both scientific research and practical AI solution development. The candidate should also have hands\-on expertise with AWS Bedrock, AWS SageMaker, and Responsible AI practices, including fairness, explainability, governance, privacy, and bias mitigation.
   

  

 This role requires a rare blend of scientific depth, engineering strength, business understanding, and the ability to work across highly ambiguous and fast\-evolving AI problem spaces.
   

  

 GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Conduct advanced research in artificial intelligence, with focus areas including machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, large language models, natural language processing, multimodal AI, and agentic AI systems.
* Design, prototype, and validate novel AI algorithms, architectures, and workflows for real\-world use cases.
* Explore and apply cutting\-edge approaches in transformers, fine\-tuning, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt optimization, autonomous agents, multi\-agent systems, model alignment, and reasoning frameworks.
* Lead experimentation across model training, evaluation, benchmarking, and optimization.
* Stay current with emerging AI advances and translate academic research and industry innovation into scalable enterprise solutions.
* Publish research findings, contribute to patents, or create internal technical thought leadership that advances the organization’s AI maturity.
* Build, fine\-tune, and optimize ML/DL models, including supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement, and self\-supervised learning systems.
* Develop and deploy LLM\-powered applications, conversational AI, summarization systems, semantic search, knowledge assistants, and intelligent automation platforms.
* Create Generative AI applications using foundation models for text, image, code, synthetic data, and multimodal outputs.
* Develop Agentic AI systems capable of task planning, tool usage, workflow orchestration, memory integration, retrieval, and decision support.
* Use AWS Bedrock to build and scale foundation model applications, including model access, orchestration, secure integration, and GenAI experimentation.
* Use AWS SageMaker for model training, tuning, experimentation, MLOps, deployment, and monitoring at scale.
* Work with structured and unstructured data across large\-scale datasets to support AI research and production systems.
* Lead or collaborate on data cleaning, feature engineering, data quality improvement, dataset curation, and annotation strategies.
* Build robust AI pipelines that integrate with enterprise data systems, APIs, cloud services, and downstream applications.
* Apply SQL, NoSQL, database modeling, and data warehousing concepts to support efficient model training and inference.
* Partner with engineering teams to productionize models with scalability, observability, reliability, and security in mind.
* Ensure all AI systems are designed and deployed with strong Responsible AI principles.
* Develop practices for fairness, transparency, interpretability, explainability, privacy, accountability, and bias mitigation.
* Assess risks associated with foundation models, LLM outputs, hallucinations, model drift, adversarial misuse, and unsafe automation.
* Implement guardrails, evaluation standards, governance frameworks, and human\-in\-the\-loop processes where necessary.
* Support compliance with evolving data privacy, security, and ethical AI requirements.
* Translate complex AI concepts into clear business value propositions for stakeholders, leadership teams, and non\-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, security, legal, data, and business teams to define AI strategy and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Mentor junior scientists, ML engineers, and data professionals.
* Contribute to roadmap planning, architecture reviews, technical hiring, and AI capability development across the organization.


**Educational Qualifications**
* PhD or master's in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, NLP, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.


**Required Qualifications**
* Strong research background with demonstrated contributions in AI/ML through publications, patents, applied research, industrial innovation, or equivalent scientific work.
* Deep knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Generative AI, Large Language Models, Agentic AI / AI Agents
* Proven experience developing advanced AI models from research through implementation and evaluation.
* Strong experience with AWS Bedrock and AWS SageMaker for foundation model development, model lifecycle management, and deployment workflows.
* Strong understanding of Responsible AI, including model governance, fairness, explainability, privacy, bias mitigation, and risk control.


**Core Technical Skills**
* Expert\-level proficiency in Python as the top priority language for AI and ML development.
* Ability to build efficient, scalable, and production\-ready code for research and enterprise AI applications.
* Strong understanding of core ML concepts, including Transformer architectures
* Hands\-on experience with leading frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras
* Experience with model selection, hyperparameter tuning, training optimization, evaluation metrics, model compression, and inference performance improvement.
* Strong expertise in NLP techniques, including text classification, NER, embeddings, summarization, semantic retrieval, question answering, sentiment analysis, and conversational AI.
* Experience building LLM applications, including prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, RAG pipelines, evaluation, grounding, and safety controls.
* Expertise in Generative AI architectures, foundation models, and enterprise use cases involving text, image, document, and multimodal generation.
* Strong experience building AI agents and autonomous workflows.
* Skills in, Agent architecture and orchestration, Tool use and function calling, Retrieval systems, Memory design, Reliability engineering, Evaluation and guardrails, Multi\-step planning and execution
* Familiarity with modern agent frameworks and orchestration patterns for enterprise\-grade agentic systems.
* Experience in Data cleaning and preprocessing, Feature engineering, SQL and database querying, Database modeling, NoSQL systems, Data warehousing, Large\-scale data handling
* Ability to work with diverse datasets and establish strong data foundations for AI systems.
* Ability to apply mathematical reasoning to model design, tuning, experimentation, and performance analysis.
* Strong experience with AWS Bedrock, AWS SageMaker, AWS data and ML services relevant to AI model development and deployment
* Familiarity with cloud\-native AI system design, scalable training, model serving, monitoring, and MLOps practices.
* Strong commitment to designing fair, accountable, transparent, and human\-centered AI systems.
* Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate ethical risks in model design, training data, inference, and deployment.
* Expertise in crafting, testing, and optimizing prompts for foundation models and LLM\-driven applications.
* Ability to design prompt strategies that improve relevance, reliability, task completion, and output quality.
* Skill in translating domain challenges into AI opportunities and practical solutions.
* Strong ability to solve complex, ambiguous, and open\-ended AI problems.
* Comfortable navigating evolving requirements, incomplete data, experimental uncertainty, and rapid technological change.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts, model limitations, trade\-offs, and business implications to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration skills across research, engineering, product, and leadership teams.
* Strong curiosity and commitment to ongoing learning in a rapidly evolving AI landscape.
* Ability to evaluate new tools, methods, and research directions and determine where they create business value.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Postdoctoral research, industrial research lab experience, or significant applied research leadership in AI.
* Strong publication record in reputable AI/ML/NLP conferences or journals.
* Experience with multimodal AI, including text, image, audio, video, or document intelligence systems.
* Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, tool\-using agents, and advanced LLM evaluation frameworks.
* Familiarity with MLOps, CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, A/B testing, and production observability.
* Knowledge of privacy\-preserving AI techniques, model security, red teaming, and governance workflows.
* Experience leading AI innovation programs or enterprise AI transformation initiatives.


**Inclusion And Diversity**
 GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

 We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.
   

  

 Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world\-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

Assistant Facilities Manager
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**Assistant Facility Manager \- Job DescriptionLocation:** Gurgaon
  
**Job Type:** Full Time
  
**Job Grade:** Assistant Manager
  
  

About JLL
  
**JLL (NYSE:** JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our vision is to reimagine the world of real estate, creating rewarding opportunities and amazing spaces where people can achieve their ambitions. In doing so, we will build a better tomorrow for our clients, our people, and our communities. JLL is a Fortune 500 company with operations in over 80 countries and a global workforce dedicated to delivering exceptional facility management solutions.
  
  

Position Overview
  
The Assistant Facility Manager will be responsible for managing all aspects of facility management service delivery during assigned shifts at our Gurgaon location. This role ensures seamless operations across technical services, soft services, vendor management, and compliance while maintaining the highest standards of safety, hygiene, and client satisfaction. The Assistant Facility Manager is accountable for completing high\-priority works and managing escalations during their shift.
  
  

What This Job Involves
  
  

Putting Safety and Comfort First
  
Your primary concern is ensuring a safer, more comfortable work environment for employees and visitors. You will plan and execute preparations for client meetings, conferences, and VIP visits while overseeing mailroom operations, front office services, and housekeeping standards. Your role is central to creating exceptional workplace experiences.
  
  

High\-Level Technical Operations
  
Coordinate with engineering teams to address technical issues promptly during shifts. Monitor critical building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety systems, DG sets, and UPS operations. Ensure preventive maintenance schedules are followed and escalate technical concerns as needed. Support sustainability initiatives including energy optimization and green building practices.
  
  

Core Soft Services Excellence
  
Manage and supervise housekeeping, security, front office, helpdesk, mailroom, and cafeteria operations. Conduct regular facility walkthroughs to ensure cleanliness, upkeep, and service quality across all areas. Implement and monitor service level agreements (SLAs) for all soft service providers. Address employee queries and concerns through phone and email communication promptly.
  
  

Budget Management and Financial Controls
  
Assist in understanding and managing office services budgets. Monitor expenditures and identify cost optimization opportunities. Track vendor invoicing and coordinate with finance teams for timely processing. Manage accruals for month\-end and year\-end closing activities.
  
  

Statutory Compliance and Safety
  
Ensure adherence to all statutory requirements including Factory Act, Building Bye\-Laws, fire safety regulations, and environmental compliance. Maintain licenses, permits, and compliance registers with proper renewal tracking. Coordinate fire drills semi\-annually and ensure emergency preparedness. Implement and monitor safety protocols across all operations.
  
  

Vendor Management
  
Supervise third\-party vendor (TPV) staff performance across security, housekeeping, cafeteria, and other services. Conduct shift briefings and ensure vendor staff deployment meets requirements. Monitor vendor performance matrices and provide monthly feedback to the Facility Manager. Ensure vendor staff grooming standards and adherence to client policies. Manage escalations with vendors and ensure timely issue resolution.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Helpdesk and Mailroom Operations
  
Provide management advice on helpdesk and mailroom escalations during shifts. Ensure immediate response to priority calls from employees and tracking systems. Manage crisis situations and follow established escalation processes. Clear government agency mail and C\-mail to proper recipients promptly.
  
  

Front Office Operations
  
Oversee front office operations and address escalated issues during shifts. Conduct regular rounds of lobby areas, front desk, and restrooms to ensure high housekeeping standards. Respond immediately to priority calls and maintain professional service standards. Coordinate VIP and client visits with front office teams.
  
  

Housekeeping Operations
  
Conduct shift briefings and monitor housekeeping deployment and performance. Coordinate with housekeeping managers on client/VIP visits. Perform facility walkthroughs covering restrooms, breakout areas, workstations, meeting rooms, and common areas. Identify snags, ensure timely closure, and report to management. Close housekeeping service requests within turnaround time (TAT) without escalations. Discuss vendor performance and provide input for monthly evaluations.
  
  

General Operations and Administration
  
Maintain breakout areas and reprographic equipment in excellent condition. Document all communications. Conduct facility walkarounds following established maps and guides. Adhere to client policies, processes, procedures, and statutory requirements. Meet agreed SLAs and KPIs with clients. Assist with ISO audits, internal audits, and external audits with proper documentation. Update operational level agreements (OLA) daily and monthly in tracking tools. Coordinate VIP visits with events teams without escalations. Maintain knowledge and functionality of facility management tools. Govern pest control, carpet maintenance, wellness rooms, ambulance services, indoor plants, recreation rooms, and gym operations. Conduct scheduled meetings and focus sessions with project teams. Participate in and manage semi\-annual fire drills. Prepare and share daily, weekly, and monthly reports on time. Maintain all relevant checklists as per requirements. Adapt to and implement new initiatives effectively.
  
  

Additional Responsibilities
  
Prepare and review duty manager, helpdesk, and mailroom rosters. Prepare and share weekly and monthly reports including MMR and facility templates. Participate in interviews for security managers, housekeeping managers, and helpdesk candidates. Assist in maintaining compliance scores across all operational parameters. Prepare and share JLL team attendance records. Support Facility Manager and Senior Facility Manager with escalations and special reports. Conduct random audits of mailroom, helpdesk, time office, visitor management systems, cafeteria counters, wellness rooms, and cloak rooms. Manage workplace stores and inventory. Conduct training sessions for team members and TPV staff on ethics, code of conduct, business continuity planning (BCP), and client\-specific policies. Train and support new team members. Ensure effective implementation of new initiatives and process improvements. Manage site operations in absence of Workplace Manager. Coordinate with transport and events teams on critical matters. Assist Workplace Manager during crisis situations and BCP activation. Maintain comprehensive knowledge of site\-specific policies and procedures.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
**Education:** Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Tertiary qualifications in hotel management, building management, or business administration preferred.
  
**Experience:** 3\-6 years of experience in facilities management within IT, corporate, hotel, or FM services industries. Minimum 3 years of industry\-specific experience required.
  
**Technical Skills:** Proficiency in MS Office Suite and email communication. Working knowledge of facility management systems and tracking tools. Understanding of budget management and financial controls. Familiarity with statutory compliance requirements and documentation.
  
**Generic Skills:** Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities. Strong vendor management and negotiation skills. Customer service orientation with problem\-solving mindset. Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities effectively.
  
**Behavioral Competencies:** Strong teamwork and collaboration abilities. Continuous learning attitude and adaptability to change. Positive thinking and proactive approach to challenges. Ability to work under pressure during shifts and emergencies.
  
  

What We Can Do for YouAt JLL, we empower you to become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We support your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive compensation, and comprehensive benefits package. You will have opportunities for professional development, career advancement, and working with industry\-leading clients on world\-class facilities.
  
Sound Like You?If you are equipped to set up teams for success, can work effectively as both a leader and team member, and have the ability to bring about positive changes while following through with implementation, we want to hear from you.
  
Apply today and join JLL in reimagining the world of real estate!
  
JLL is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

* Ensure timely submissions while maintaining quality and compliance standards.

 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



 Experience
 


* 4–9 years of hands\-on experience in US IT Staffing and Recruitment.
* Proven experience supporting requirements from System Integrators (SIs) and Implementation Partners.

 Sourcing \& Recruiting Skills
 


* Expertise in end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle management.

 Search Tools \& Technologies

* LinkedIn Recruiter

* Indeed

* CareerBuilder
* Boolean Search Techniques
* X\-Ray Search
* Google Advanced Search
* ATS and CRM platforms
* Social Media Recruiting Tools



 Communication Skills
 


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong candidate engagement and relationship\-building abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with clients, account managers, hiring managers, and candidates.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience supporting large SI/Implementation Partner accounts.
* Strong network of IT consultants across multiple technologies.
* Experience recruiting for high\-volume and niche technology requirements.
* Ability to work independently in a target\-driven environment.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.



 Key Competencies
 


* End\-to\-End Recruitment
* Niche Skill Hiring
* Candidate Screening \& Evaluation
* Boolean \& X\-Ray Search Expertise
* Pipeline Building
* Relationship Management
* Offer Negotiation
* Time Management
* Team Collaboration
* Result\-Oriented Execution



 What We Are Looking For
 



 A recruiter who can consistently deliver quality submissions, thoroughly screen profiles, leverage the latest sourcing technologies, and successfully support demanding requirements from leading System Integrators and Implementation Partners while working in the US CST time zone

description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility\-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data\-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
   

  

**Come Join Our Team!**
* As part of our robust Rewards \& Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance\-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards


**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**
* The Accounts Receivable (“AR”) Specialists are primarily responsible for analyzing collections, resolving non\-payables, and handling bill inquiries for more complex issues. AR Specialists are responsible for insurance payer follow\-up ensuring claims are paid according to client contracts. Complies with all applicable laws regarding billing standards.


**Essential Functions And Tasks**
* Follows up on claim rejections and denials to ensure appropriate reimbursement for our clients.
* Process assigned AR work lists provided by the manager in a timely manner.
* Write appeals using established guidelines to resolve claim denials with a goal of one contact resolution.
* Identified and resolved denied, non\-paid, and/or non\-adjudicated claims and billing issues due to coverage issues, medical record requests, and authorizations.
* Recommend accounts to be written off on Adjustment Request.
* Reports address and/or filing rule changes to the manager.
* Check the system for missing payments.
* Properly notates patient accounts.
* Review each piece of correspondence to determine specific problems.
* Research patient accounts.
* Reviews accounts and determines appropriate follow\-up actions (adjustments, letters, phone insurance, etc.).
* Processes and follows up on appeals. Files appeals on claim denials.
* Inbound/outbound calls may be required for follow\-up on accounts.
* Respond to insurance company claim inquiries.
* Communicates with insurance companies about the status of outstanding claims.
* Meet established production and quality standards as set by Ventra Health.
* Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* High School Diploma or GED.
* At least one (1\) year in the data entry field and one (1\) year in medical billing and claims resolution preferred.
* AAHAM and/or HFMA certification preferred.
* Experience with offshore engagement and collaboration desired.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Intermediate level knowledge of medical billing rules, such as coordination of benefits, modifiers, Medicare, and Medicaid, and understanding of EOBs.
* Become proficient in the use of billing software within 4 weeks and maintain proficiency.
* Ability to read, understand and apply state/federal laws, regulations, and policies.
* Ability to communicate with diverse personalities in a tactful, mature, and professional manner.
* Ability to remain flexible and work within a collaborative and fast\-paced environment.
* Basic use of a computer, telephone, internet, copier, fax, and scanner.
* Basic touch 10 key skills.
* Basic Math skills.

**Job Title: US IT Recruiter (Mid\-Level) – W2 Hiring \| Onsite Opportunity** 




  





**About Galent** 




 Galent is a talent solutions company focused on delivering exceptional recruitment and workforce solutions. We partner with organizations to identify and hire top technology talent through innovative sourcing strategies and streamlined recruitment processes.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **US IT Recruiter** 
 with
 **2\- 6** 
**years of experience** 
 in US staffing and recruitment. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of
 **W2 hiring** 
 , proven experience in sourcing, engaging, and closing top IT talent across the US market.
 



  





 This role is ideal for recruiters who are passionate about technology hiring, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and have a proven ability to deliver quality candidates while managing end\-to\-end recruitment activities.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Chennai \- Onsite
 



**Shift:** 
 US Business Hours (may require evening/night hours based on business needs)
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 



* Understand client requirements and develop effective sourcing strategies.
* Source and recruit qualified IT professionals across the US market.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of
 **W2 recruitment processes** 
 and candidate engagement.
* Support enterprise\-level clients and high\-volume recruitment requirements.
* Utilize job portals, social media platforms, professional networks, and other sourcing tools to identify qualified talent.
* Screen candidates based on technical skills, experience, availability, and overall job fit.
* Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and clients.
* Maintain accurate candidate records, trackers, and internal databases.
* Meet recruitment targets while maintaining quality hiring standards.
* Stay updated with market trends, sourcing techniques, and recruitment tools.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 



* Minimum
 **2 \- 6 years of experience in US IT Recruitment** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of
 **W2 hiring and US staffing processes** 
 .
* Experience handling IT requirements across multiple technologies.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-level clients or high\-volume recruitment environments preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong sourcing and candidate relationship management skills.
* Ability to work in a target\-driven, fast\-paced environment.
* Strong interpersonal, organizational, and coordination skills.
* Willingness to work according to US business hours.

**Job Title:** HR Recruiter  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Gender:** Any

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a passionate and dynamic **HR Recruiter** to manage our full\-cycle recruitment process, from identifying potential hires to interviewing and evaluating candidates. The ideal candidate will have experience in screening candidates, building pipelines, and creating a positive candidate experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and role requirements
* Post job openings on various job boards, social media, and internal platforms
* Source potential candidates through online channels (e.g., LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed)
* Screen resumes and conduct initial phone screens
* Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and hiring teams
* Assist in crafting job descriptions and interview questions that reflect each position’s requirements
* Provide timely feedback to candidates and hiring managers
* Maintain and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system (ATS)
* Assist in employer branding initiatives and job fair planning when needed
* Track key recruiting metrics (e.g., time\-to\-hire, source of hire)

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong decision\-making and organizational skills
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
**What is the mission of the Recruiting team at Pocket FM?** 




  





 We are who we are because of our people. The mission of this team is to always ensure we hire better than 80% of the people currently performing in their roles.
 



  





 Recruiting is step 1 towards building and maintaining an organization. Your role is sacred. You are the gatekeeper of the culture. Shaping the public perception of what we represent. Giving people a reason to join. Making working with Pocket FM irresistible.
 



  





 Our kind of recruiting is a mix of HR and sales, with a strong shot of marketing. Recruiters must simultaneously attract the right audience, size up a candidate, and sell them on the company. Pocket FM is only as good as its talent.
 



 It is about doing certain things right every single day. Brilliance comes from doing the basics right.
 



  





**What is the breadth and depth you will have to go to aid this?** 




  





 As a recruiter, you are expected to be a strong filter and make a decision after your conversations. For this, there is a need to learn how to articulate your ‘gut feeling’ and provide a ‘yes’ or ‘no’ answer.
 



  




* Source smarter, not louder. Sourcing is a very critical aspect of your role. Scouting passive talent from the industry and using out\-of\-the\-box sources through marketing and networking would help you meet your deliverables within the deadline. Daily, you need to identify great talent from a combination of sources and get them through the door
* Driving successful referral campaigns; our people are the best sources
 *(yes, there are many different ways of driving referral programs)* 
 . Enabling the business to generate more referrals is a very critical aspect of your role
* Be a pipeline Ninja. Maintaining a constant pipeline
 *(\~3x of targets),* 
 which ensures a solid talent pool from which we can meet our hiring requirements
* Hiring priorities shift fast. Agility and business fluency are must\-haves. Lead through change
* Protect the candidate experience. How we treat candidates reflects how we operate as a business
* You must go beyond requisitions. Understanding the why behind a hire is just as critical as the how. Influence business outcomes
* Zero tolerance for mediocrity. You raise the bar. You understand the silent cost of “adequate” hires and never settle. Because you know that one wrong hire can bring down the energy, efficiency, and performance of an entire team



  





  





**What do you need to bring to the table to perform well?** 




  




* Are you a good storyteller?
* What kind of mindset do you have? Do you think you have a learning mindset?
* Be courteous, be conversational, be rigorous, and be realistic
* Being on the same page with your stakeholders is the base starting point of your success
* Predicting the success of the candidate is your success here; hope is not a strategy
* You need to be well\-versed in the products. You cannot be on the back foot in your conversations

Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced Sourcing Specialist to join our team at Randstad Enterprise supporting North America(NAM) region. The ideal candidate will have 4\+ years of recruitment experience, strong sourcing and research skills, and the ability to identify, engage, and screen top talent for Fortune 500 clients.
 



  





 If you’re passionate about talent sourcing, enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment, and have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, we’d love to hear from you!
 



  





**Position Summary** 




  





**Role** 
 : Sourcing Specialist
 




  





**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (Hybrid)
 



  





**Shift Hours:** 
 5:30 PM \- 2:30 AM IST
 



  





**Roles and responsibilities** 




  





**What will you do?** 




 As a Sourcing Specialist you will be responsible for proactively seeking to identify entry to senior level talent, primarily through effective and diligent Internet, database, and social media searches.
 


* You will quickly analyse social data and resumes to engage qualified candidates.
* You will be responsible for market and talent research ascertaining likely sourcing opportunities for well\- matched candidates and complete detailed Master Sourcing Plans.
* If a short listing assignment is undertaken you will conduct first level interviews to determine if there is a match to the client's needs.
* A tenacious knack to quickly execute research techniques and a determination to uncover hidden online information is essential for success. The ability to work in a fast paced, changing environment, where you will manage your daily activity to identify leads and engage people online and over the phone is vital.
* This exciting opportunity allows you to partner with multi\-location and/or global colleagues and assemble and execute appropriate sourcing methods to produce quality candidates for our clients.



**Vacancy Intake:** 




 Organize/join intake with the hiring manager/recruiter in order to get a complete picture of hard and soft requirements, culture and working environment.
 



 Identify screening criteria together with the client/recruiter.
 



 Upon completion of the intake meeting, create a master sourcing plan with appropriate sourcing strategy.
 



  





**Identification:** 




 Analyse job description and translate to search queries, to be used in database mining in various channels such as internal candidate database, job board databases, internet searches (Google and other web searches, LinkedIn and other social networks), and in some cases phone sourcing etc. as requested.
 



 Review CV’s for pattern recognition to guide search queries.
 



 Determine eligibility of candidates based on paper CV.
 



 Diligent internet research to find hidden information (passive candidates).
 



 Putting together a Master Sourcing Plan where applicable.
 



  





**Engagement, Screening and Submission:** 




 Make first and further connections with candidates.
 



 Engage and communicate with prospective candidates.
 



 Carry out remote interviews.
 



 Verbal review of qualifications.
 



 Determine fit of the candidate with the client’s organization.
 



 Create Candidate Profiling Form.
 



 Submit and position candidates on employment opportunities.
 



  





**Reporting:** 




 Daily/Weekly reporting of search and screening activity into the Delivery Manager and client.
 



 Make real\-time updates for timely and accurate record keeping of candidate activity and productivity.
 



  





**Relationship management :** 




 Act as clients / client facing recruiters ‘single point of contact’ (SPOC) from a daily delivery/operational perspective.
 



  





**What will you bring?** 



* 4\+ years in recruitment
* Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
* Experience in Non\-IT Recruitment is preferred.
* Excellent communication, presentation and customer service skills.
* Should have excellent written communication skills.
* Knowledge of social media and social networking sites.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple requisition assignments across 1 or more industry sectors
* Demonstrated evidence of solid time management and organizational skills
* Demonstrated ability to self\-motivate, set goals and meet deadlines
* Customer service focus and ability to maintain courteous and professional working relationships



  





**What's in it for you?** 




 ● Join a global market leader in HR services with industry recognition
 



 ● Join a diverse and inclusive workplace
 



 ● Join a company with a wide range of learning, development and advancement opportunities
 



 ● Join a company that offers a great work/life balance
 



 ● Join a company with proven processes and high\-output technology to create efficiency
 



  





**please note** 




 Randstad is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome people from all walks of life \- race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected group status.
 



 At Randstad, we welcome people of all abilities and want to ensure that our hiring and interview process meets the needs of all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation to make your application or interview experience a great one, please just let us know.

**About the Role:**
 We are looking for proactive and data\-driven Talent Acquisition professionals with 4\+ years of experience to manage end\-to\-end recruitment while bringing analytics and strategic insights to our hiring processes. This role balances hands\-on recruitment with strategic thinking, helping WIN attract top talent efficiently and effectively.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle across functions, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand talent needs and recommend effective hiring strategies.
* Develop creative sourcing strategies to attract both active and passive candidates.
* Post and manage job openings on platforms like LinkedIn and Naukri, ensuring timely and accurate updates.
* Maintain and manage recruitment workflows in Greenhouse ATS, ensuring accurate candidate tracking and reporting.
* Track and report recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, source effectiveness, and candidate pipeline health.
* Analyze recruitment data to identify bottlenecks, trends, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Support workforce planning with insights on talent availability and market trends.

description:
**About the job** 




**Job Title:** 
 HR Onboarding Specialist
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Reports to:** 
 Manager HR
 



**About Ceres India** 




 At Ceres India Private Limited, we support initiatives that help communities recover, rebuild, and strengthen resilience. As part of the Ceres Global network of companies, we contribute to disaster recovery, infrastructure restoration, environmental services, and critical response operations through engineering, technology, innovation, and operational excellence. From India, we help enable faster decisions, stronger delivery, and meaningful outcomes where they matter most. The purpose is at the core of what we do. We are building an environment where talent can do meaningful work, take ownership, grow with the business, and be part of something larger than themselves.
 



**Driven by Purpose, Powered by People** 




 At Ceres India, we believe youre more than just an employee; you’re part of a team with a purpose and a meaningful mission. Every team member plays a vital role in restoring hope, helping communities recover and rebuild.
 



 We value initiative, respect diversity, and give our people the freedom to lead. We offer competitive pay, growth opportunities, travel, and a culture built on resilience and teamwork. If you show up with compassion, share the commitment, react with urgency, and deliver solutions, you’ll fit right in. We don’t just respond to challenges; we rise to them.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The Onboarding Specialist – US Operations is responsible for managing end\-to\-end employee onboarding, ensuring a smooth and compliant transition for new hires using HRMS platforms such as Paycom. The role partners closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and IT teams to deliver an excellent new\-hire experience.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage full\-cycle onboarding for US employees (exempt and non\-exempt).
* Initiate and track I\-9 verification and E\-Verify compliance
* Ensure completion of W\-4, state tax forms, direct deposit, and policy acknowledgements
* Configure and maintain onboarding workflows in HRMS tool (Paycom preferred)
* Initiate and track pre\-employment checks, documentation, drug screening vendors and compliance forms
* Coordinate with Payroll and Benefits teams for timely employee setup
* Ensure data accuracy across HR systems and employee records
* Communicate onboarding timelines and expectations to new hires and stakeholders
* Support audits, reporting, and HR metrics related to onboarding
* Troubleshoot HRMS system issues and provide user support



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 5\-6 years of experience in US onboarding / HR operations
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS tools – Paycom (preferred)
* Strong understanding of onboarding compliance and employment documentation
* Strong knowledge of US employment compliance (I\-9, E\-Verify, W\-4, state new\-hire reporting)
* Excellent attention to detail and data management skills
* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination abilities
* Experience supporting US onboarding processes is a plus
* Flexibility to work across US Timezones


- 


**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience supporting multi\-state US onboarding
* Exposure to high\-volume or remote onboarding
* Knowledge of US payroll and benefits processes
* Experience working with background check vendors



  





**What To Expect** 




 This is a fast\-paced, detail\-oriented role focused on delivering a seamless onboarding experience for new hires across the US. You'll manage multiple onboarding activities simultaneously, ensuring compliance with employment requirements while coordinating closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, IT, and hiring managers. Success in this role requires strong organization, accuracy, and the ability to adapt to changing hiring volumes and priorities while providing excellent support to new employees and stakeholders.
 



**Why Join Ceres India?** 




 At Ceres India, you won’t just have a job, you’ll have a mission. Your work will directly impact the speed and strength of community recovery after disasters.
 



**We Offer** 



* A collaborative, mission\-driven culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* The chance to make a lasting difference for communities.

description:
**Career Area**
 Human Resources
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to develop and execute recruitment strategies aligned with organizational goals and workforce plans.
* Provide market intelligence, talent insights, and data\-driven recommendations to support hiring decisions.
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessment coordination, reference checks, offer negotiation, and onboarding support.
* Utilize Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Candidate Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, and advanced sourcing tools to identify and engage top talent.
* Build and maintain robust talent pipelines to support current and future hiring needs.
* Implement sourcing strategies focused on attracting diverse and high\-quality talent while optimizing time\-to\-fill and cost\-per\-hire metrics.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience through proactive communication and effective stakeholder management.
* Monitor recruitment metrics and leverage workforce analytics to improve hiring outcomes and process efficiencies.
* Promote employer branding initiatives and represent the organization positively in the talent marketplace.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, employment legislation, and recruitment best practices.


**Skill Descriptors**
 Relationship Management
   

  

**Knowledge of relationship management techniques and the ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with business leaders, candidates, vendors, and peers.**
* Influences hiring managers and business leaders through data\-driven recommendations.
* Builds and maintains long\-term partnerships with key stakeholders and external vendors.


 Customer/Market Focus
   

  

**Understanding of evolving market trends and the ability to respond to customer and business needs in a manner that consistently adds value.**
* Identifies expressed and unexpressed business talent needs.
* Aligns recruiting strategies to critical business objectives.


 Recruitment Channel Management
   

  

**Knowledge of selecting, implementing, and managing recruitment channels to support talent acquisition objectives.**
* Utilizes multiple recruitment channels to attract top talent.
* Identifies and manages cost\-effective sourcing partners and recruitment vendors.


 Candidate Screening
   

  

**Knowledge of effective candidate assessment and screening methodologies.**
* Screens candidates for professional, technical, and leadership roles.
* Ensures compliance with HR policies and recruitment standards throughout the screening process.


 Candidate Sourcing
   

  

**Knowledge of sourcing techniques, methods, and tools to attract top talent.**
* Develops and executes multi\-channel sourcing strategies.
* Advises business leaders on talent availability and sourcing approaches.
* Benchmarks sourcing strategies against industry best practices.


 Staffing and Recruiting
   

  

**Knowledge of staffing strategies, recruiting processes, and talent acquisition best practices.**
* Manages complex recruitment assignments across multiple business functions.
* Consults with stakeholders on workforce planning, recruitment strategies, and talent availability.


 Workforce Analytics
   

  

**Knowledge of HR metrics, workforce trends, and reporting methodologies that support informed business decisions.**
* Analyzes recruitment and workforce data to identify trends and opportunities.
* Generates reports and dashboards to support leadership decision\-making.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* At minimal 4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, or Human Resources.
* Proven experience managing end\-to\-end recruitment for technical, professional hiring.
* Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills.
* Experience using ATS, CRM platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing technologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume recruitment environment preferred.


 This position requires working onsite five days a week.
   

  

 Relocation is available for this position.
   

  

**Posting Dates**
 September 8, 2026 \- September 17, 2026
   

  

 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
   

  

 Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

description:
**Talent Acquisition Associate \| In\-Office \| Andheri\-East** 




  





**About the Job** 



* **Role:** 
 Talent Acquisition Associate
* **Location:** 
 Head Office, Andheri East; 2\-3 times a month Bandra (Clinic)
* **Working days:** 
 6 days a week
* **Experience:** 
 1–3 years



  





**This is an early career, Individual Contributor role. Please apply only if you meet the criteria.** 




  





**About the company** 




  





 Our client is a fast\-growing
 
 Venture Capital funded, Seed startup in women's healthcare
 
 , scaling up its network of centres across India. As they expand, they're building out a strong on\-ground team to support both clinical and non\-clinical hiring at the centre level.
 



  





**Why does this role exist?** 




  





 As our client grows both its clinic footprint and its business teams (sales, marketing, finance, ops, HR), hiring needs span a wide range of functions and seniority levels at once. This role exists to be the single point of ownership for generalist recruitment who will move fluidly between healthcare and non\-healthcare hiring, corporate roles and clinic\-based roles, as the business's needs shift.
 



  





**What you will own:** 




  




* End\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle across a broad mix of roles: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer rollout, and onboarding handoff (ex: Sales, Marketing, Growth, Healthcare operations, Finance, Generalists)
* Building and maintaining talent pipelines across sourcing channels (job portals, referrals, agencies, socials)
* Coordinating with hiring managers across functions to understand requirements and prioritize open positions
* Periodic on\-site visits to clinics (2–3 times a month) for hiring coordination and stakeholder alignment
* Tracking recruitment metrics: time\-to\-fill, offer\-to\-join ratio, source effectiveness
* Maintaining accurate hiring dashboard records for visibility to stakeholders



  





**Who you are?** 




  




* 1–3 years of recruitment experience as a generalist, comfortable moving across functions and role types rather than specializing in one
* Based at the head office, with periodic on\-site clinic visits
* Organised and process\-driven: Can manage multiple open roles across very different functions at once without dropping the ball
* Strong communication skills; able to represent the employer brand well to a wide range of candidate profiles
* Self\-starter who can operate with minimal hand\-holding in a fast\-scaling environment
* Prior exposure to both healthcare and non\-healthcare hiring is a plus, but not mandatory



  





**What this role is not:** 




  




* This is not a specialist recruiter role limited to one function (e.g. only tech, or only clinical). It's a true generalist mandate
* This is not a remote role.
* This is not a senior/strategic TA leadership role. It's an individual contributor position.

description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

 We are hiring a Global Talent Acquisition Partner who operates less like a traditional recruiter and more like a builder. This role owns Product, Engineering, and Design hiring in India with exposure to US and EMEA reqs and some GTM hiring.
   

  

 A lot of what we hire sits at the intersection of AI, product, and platform. Terms like RLHF, SFT, and foundation model work should already mean something to you before the intake call. On the GTM side, you should know whether a role calls for a PLG\-motion seller, an enterprise AE, or a RevOps operator and understand how ARR stage and ICP shape that answer. You follow what AI\-first startups are building for and bring those signals into how you run searches here.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own full\-cycle hiring across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM, including select US and EMEA reqs
* Build sourcing workflows using AI tools and agents, not inbound pipelines or third\-party agencies
* Advise hiring managers and leadership directly: bring market data, calibrate scope, and push back when the brief doesn't hold
* Take on ambiguous and net\-new roles with no existing playbook and build one as you go
* Present pipeline health, market insight, and hiring recommendations to senior leadership


**Who You Are**
* 4 to 8 years of full\-cycle recruiting; technical or GTM background preferred
* High\-agency by default: you propose the plan, execute it, and don't wait for a perfect brief to start
* You build relationships with candidates ahead of open reqs, not just to fill them
* Actively using AI tools in your sourcing and screening workflow today, not planning to
* Can hold a room with a function head or founder and present pipeline or market data without over\-preparing
* Bangalore\-based, with flexibility for US time zone overlap


**This role isn't for you if**
* You need a defined playbook before you can start
* You rely on inbound or agencies to build pipeline
* You're not already using AI in your day\-to\-day recruiting workflow

description:
**What's Ditto?** 




 At Ditto, we help people understand insurance well enough to make well\-informed decisions — from expert advice to smooth policy purchases to dedicated claim support, backed by our industry\-first no\-spam commitment. Over 700,000 users have trusted us with their insurance decisions, and we hold a 4\.9 rating with 30,000\+ reviews on Google.
 



 Ditto is backed by Zerodha, India's largest stockbroker.
 



  





**The Context** 




 Ditto is scaling fast. Our advisory team alone hires at high volume, and we're opening up roles across marketing, ops, tech, and specialised regional and multilingual hiring.
 



 The bottleneck at this scale isn't screening candidates. It's finding them — reaching the right people in markets where the obvious channels don't work, and building pipelines that consistently deliver on tough briefs.
 



 That's what this role owns.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll own sourcing across multiple positions — advisory bulk hiring at scale, non\-advisory specialised hiring, regional and multilingual pipelines. You'll report into the HR team and work closely with hiring managers across departments.
 



 Some examples of what you might own:
 


* **Bulk regional pipelines —** 
 build the sourcing engine for Tamil\-, Telugu\-, or Kannada\-speaking advisor hires — where LinkedIn and Naukri don't get you all the way, and you need to find channels that do.
* **Specialised non\-advisory hiring —** 
 source for niche roles in marketing, ops, or tech where the candidate pool is small and passive engagement matters more than volume.
* **Agency management —** 
 onboard and manage recruitment agencies as an extension of the sourcing function — with real accountability on quality, not just volume.
* **Talent mapping —** 
 build competitor and market maps for recurring and strategic hires, so we're not sourcing cold every time.



 Whatever the role, you own the sourcing end\-to\-end — from strategy to first response.
 



  





**How This Role Evolves** 




 Excel at sourcing and other TA roles open up over time — TA Lead, specialised ownership of bulk\-hiring or non\-advisory hiring, lateral moves as the function grows. That's not the point of the role, it's what tends to happen when the craft is real. If your plan is to escape sourcing as fast as possible, this isn't the right role.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 4–6 years of hands\-on sourcing, with real ownership of bulk or high\-volume mandates.
* Strong craft : Boolean, X\-ray, LinkedIn advanced search, passive candidate outreach. The sourcing toolkit at working depth, not surface\-familiar.
* Experience sourcing across channels beyond LinkedIn and Naukri — regional portals, communities, referrals, agencies. You know where different candidate profiles actually live.
* Comfort managing recruitment agencies as an extension of your own sourcing. You communicate the spec, hold partners to quality, and know when to push back.
* Enough analytical range to read funnel data and diagnose what's not converting.
* Bias toward finding talent where others can't. That's the muscle we're hiring for.



  





**A note on what this role is not** 




 This is not a coordination or scheduling role. If you want to run interview logistics and calendar management, this will frustrate you. It's not a role where you hand mandates to agencies and wait for callbacks — you're doing the sourcing yourself, at scale. And it's not for someone whose plan is to get out of sourcing as fast as possible. The craft is the job. If you do it well, other TA roles open up — but only because you were great at sourcing first.
 



  





**Why Join Ditto** 



* Real ownership of a sourcing function at a company scaling hiring significantly.
* A TA team that's building forward, not maintaining what exists.
* Direct visibility into how a growing company gets built — you're the first conversation many joiners have with Ditto.
* Craft compounds. Great sourcing here sets you up for the TA roles that open up as we scale.
* A company where the mission is genuinely lived — a 4\.9 Google rating from 30,000\+ users tells its own story.



  





**Perks** 



* Comprehensive health and term insurance.
* Compensation as per industry standards.
* Learning allowances and growth opportunities.



  





**Our Interview Process** 




 We want to respect your time. There are 4 rounds, and we aim to complete all of them within 3 weeks.
 



  





**The schedule:** 



1. 1\. Introductory call with HR
2. 2\. Task / Assignment (3 business days from receipt)
3. 3\. Task presentation \+ Case discussion with the Hiring Manager
4. 4\. Founders round

description:
**Associate Director/Senior Manager – Leadership Hiring**
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear – to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
   

  

 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
   

  

 We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.
   

  

 If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The quality of leadership talent determines the trajectory of a company.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Manager / Associate Director – Leadership Hiring to build and scale CoinDCX's leadership talent engine. This role will own hiring across Director, VP, SVP, CXO, and other critical leadership mandates, partnering closely with founders and senior executives to identify, engage, assess, and hire transformational leaders.
   

  

 This is not a traditional recruiting role. It requires deep talent intelligence, exceptional stakeholder management, strong assessment capabilities, and the ability to influence high\-stakes hiring decisions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 You will lead Leadership Hiring across six strategic pillars.
   

  

* Leadership Talent Acquisition
* Build leadership teams that accelerate business growth.
* Own end\-to\-end hiring for Director, AVP, VP, SVP, CXO, and critical strategic roles.
* Partner with founders and business leaders to define leadership talent requirements.
* Develop bespoke search strategies for complex and high\-impact mandates.
* Drive successful closure of business\-critical leadership positions.
* Executive Search \& Talent Intelligence
* Build market conviction before initiating search.
* Conduct leadership talent mapping across relevant industries and ecosystems.
* Develop a deep understanding of organizational structures, leadership talent pools, and succession movements.
* Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation, and competitive landscapes.
* Build long\-term relationships with high\-caliber leadership talent.
* Leadership Assessment \& Evaluation
* Raise the leadership bar with every hire.
* Assess candidates across leadership capability, strategic thinking, functional expertise, and cultural alignment.
* Drive structured evaluation frameworks and hiring calibrations.
* Partner with stakeholders to ensure objective and high\-quality hiring decisions.
* Act as a trusted advisor throughout the assessment process.
* Founder \& Executive Partnership
* Operate as a strategic talent partner to leadership.
* Work closely with founders and senior executives on talent strategy and succession priorities.
* Challenge assumptions and provide data\-backed hiring recommendations.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders during complex hiring decisions.
* Ensure a high\-touch and confidential candidate experience.
* Metrics, Governance \& Search Excellence
* Bring rigor and predictability to leadership hiring.
* Own leadership hiring metrics, search progress, and stakeholder reporting.
* Ensure strong search governance, process discipline, and hiring documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement in leadership hiring practices.
* Maintain high standards of confidentiality and professionalism.
* Leadership Brand \& Talent Networks
* Build CoinDCX's reputation within leadership talent markets.
* Develop relationships with industry leaders, founders, operators, and investors.
* Build long\-term executive talent communities across key functions.
* Strengthen CoinDCX's positioning as a destination for top leadership talent.
* Leverage networks and referrals to access exceptional talent.


**You'll Excel In This Role If You**
* 8–12 years of experience in leadership hiring, executive search, or strategic talent acquisition.
* Proven track record of hiring Director, VP, SVP, and CXO\-level talent across multiple functions in fintech,startup companies.
* Strong talent mapping, market intelligence, and executive assessment capabilities.
* Experience partnering directly with founders, business heads, and executive leadership teams.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to operate with discretion, judgment, and confidentiality.


**Core Competencies We Value**
 Executive Search \& Talent Mapping
   

  

* Leadership market mapping
* Organizational intelligence
* Succession identification
* Competitive talent research


 Executive Assessment
   

  

* Leadership evaluation
* Competency\-based interviewing
* Executive referencing
* Hiring calibration


 Strategic Partnership
   

  

* Founder and executive stakeholder management
* Talent advisory
* Influence and negotiation
* Strategic problem\-solving


 Data \& Search Operations
   

  

* Search analytics
* Talent market insights
* Hiring governance
* Process excellence


**Strong Advantage**
* Experience hiring leadership talent within technology and non technology functions in fintech, internet, consumer\-tech, or startup ecosystems.
* Background in executive search firms and/or in\-house leadership hiring functions.
* Experience building functions and leadership teams in high\-growth environments.
* Strong network across technology, product, growth, business, and corporate leadership talent.


**You'll Know You're Winning When**
* Critical leadership mandates are consistently closed with exceptional talent.
* Founders and executives trust your judgment and talent recommendations.
* Leadership talent pipelines exist ahead of business demand.
* CoinDCX is recognized as a destination for top leadership talent.
* Hiring quality and stakeholder satisfaction remain consistently high.


**Why This Role Matters \& What's In It For You**
 Great companies are built by great leaders.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and talent, influencing some of the most important hiring decisions at CoinDCX. You will work closely with founders and leadership teams to shape the future of the organization through exceptional talent.
   

  

**Hiring Process**
* Application Review
* Recruiter Connect
* Leadership Hiring Deep Dive
* Executive Search Simulation
* Stakeholder \& Influence Assessment
* Culture \& Values Discussion


**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
 If you're passionate about identifying exceptional leaders, influencing strategic talent decisions, and helping build the future of finance, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Join CoinDCX and help us build the leadership team that will define the next chapter of digital assets in India.

description:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**A hybrid working model**
 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around three days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

**What does a Recruiter do at WPP Production?**
 We are looking for a highly driven, data\-oriented Recruiter to support hiring across our Hyderabad (HYD) market, working closely with stakeholders based in California.
   

  

 This role requires someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment and can operate with both speed and precision. Beyond execution, the Recruiter will act as a strategic partner to hiring teams—using data, market insights, and strong storytelling to influence decisions, guide stakeholders, and continuously improve hiring outcomes. Given that key stakeholders sit in CA, this role also requires strong cross\-time zone communication, relationship\-building, and the ability to manage stakeholders remotely with clarity and confidence.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role in a globally integrated team, where adaptability, ownership, and a proactive mindset are critical.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage full\-cycle recruitment across full\-time and freelance roles for the HYD market.
* Partner closely with hiring managers and leadership based in CA, managing relationships and communication effectively across time zones and geography.
* Lead initial screening, assess candidates against role requirements, and present strong, well\-qualified shortlists with clear recommendations.
* Leverage recruiting data, market insights, and pipeline analytics to inform hiring strategies and improve efficiency.
* Ensure a seamless interview process, including scheduling, coordination, and follow\-ups across time zones, maintaining a strong candidate experience.
* Partner with HR and stakeholders to manage offers, aligning on compensation, contracts, and start dates.
* Develop creative sourcing strategies to build strong, diverse talent pipelines within the HYD market.
* Operate as part of a global recruiting model, flexing to support other regions occasionally based on hiring demand.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes, tools, and ways of working.
* Represent WPP Production as a strong brand ambassador, ensuring a consistent and compelling candidate experience.
* Provide administrative assistance as needed, including coordination tasks to support the broader recruiting team and hiring process.


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of recruiting experience, ideally within digital, creative, or content production environments.
* Experience managing a high volume of roles and candidates within a single market.
* Proven ability to manage stakeholders remotely across time zones, particularly with US\-based teams, with clear, confident, and proactive communication.
* Strong ability to use data and insights to drive decisions, track performance, and improve outcomes.
* Ability to clearly articulate candidate value, influence hiring teams, and guide stakeholders through hiring decisions—even without in\-person interaction.
* Brings new ideas, challenges the status quo, and continuously looks for better ways to deliver results.
* Moves with speed while maintaining quality and attention to detail.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Builds trust and credibility with stakeholders and candidates at all levels, across geographies and cultures.
* Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (Greenhouse preferred).


**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
