title: Technical Recruiter
description:
**About the Role:** 




 The Technical Recruiter will be responsible for end\-to\-end hiring delivery of technology and support roles for:
 


* Arcot Group companies – Arcitech.ai, AllTalent.com, Haire.ai, ProSchool.ai and other internal projects.
* External client mandates that require tech talent and support staff.



 This is a hands\-on, target\-driven role focused on active, outbound sourcing – not just processing incoming applications.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 You will:
 


* Own the recruitment lifecycle for assigned roles – from intake to joining.
* Focus mainly on tech positions while also handling non\-tech/support hiring depending on business needs.
* Spend a significant portion of your time on proactive sourcing via LinkedIn, job portals, and communities, rather than only relying on direct applicants.
* Work closely with the Recruitment Manager and hiring managers to close positions within agreed timelines and quality standards.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 1\. Requirement Understanding \& Role Briefing
 


* Attend detailed intake meetings with the Recruitment Manager / hiring managers to understand:
* Tech stack, tools, and frameworks required
* Must\-have vs good\-to\-have skills
* Experience range, budget, and location preferences
* Role context, reporting, and career growth
* Ask clarifying questions where needed and ensure screening criteria and search strategy are clearly defined before sourcing.



  





 2\. Sourcing \& Talent Pipeline Building
 


* Take full ownership of active sourcing, not just processing applicants from posted jobs.
* Use LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, and other job portals extensively to identify and reach out to relevant candidates.
* Build and continuously refine Boolean search strings and advanced search filters to narrow down to the right profiles quickly.
* Proactively send connection requests, InMails, emails, and job portal messages to targeted candidates with tailored outreach, followed by systematic follow\-ups.
* Tap into multiple channels beyond job boards:
* Employee and external referrals
* GitHub / Stack Overflow and other tech communities
* WhatsApp/Telegram groups, alumni networks, meetups, and online forums
* Build and maintain role\-wise talent pools for recurring roles such as:
* Developers (frontend, backend, full\-stack, mobile)
* DevOps / Cloud / SRE
* Data / AI / ML engineers
* QA / Automation testers
* Product and business analysts
* Support roles (operations, customer success, sales, marketing, etc.)
* Ensure all sourcing activity and candidate touchpoints are logged accurately in the ATS / trackers.



  





 3\. Screening \& Assessment
 


* Conduct initial telephonic / video screening to evaluate:
* Technical skills and relevant stack exposure
* Complexity and relevance of previous projects
* Communication skills and cultural fit
* Alignment with compensation, notice period, location, and work setup expectations
* Coordinate technical assessments / coding tests / assignments as required and follow up for completion.
* Quickly calibrate profiles with the Recruitment Manager / hiring managers by sharing a first batch of sourced candidates and aligning on what “good” looks like.
* Present shortlisted candidates with structured notes (skills summary, notice period, CTC, reasons for fit, potential risks).



  





 4\. Interview Coordination \& Process Management
 


* Schedule interviews with internal stakeholders and/or clients, sharing clear information with candidates (role, panel, format).
* Ensure interviewers have updated resumes, your screening notes, and any test results in advance.
* Keep candidates informed about timelines, feedback expectations, and next steps.
* Collect and record structured feedback from interviewers; update ATS/trackers promptly.
* Escalate bottlenecks or delays to the Recruitment Manager and propose solutions (parallel pipelines, wider search, adjusted criteria, etc.).



  





 5\. Offer Management \& Joining
 


* Support the Recruitment Manager / HR in preparing offer details / CTC structures.
* Clearly explain offer components to candidates and handle queries around salary structure, benefits, and role expectations.
* Manage offer negotiation within guidelines and keep candidates engaged until joining (check\-ins, documentation support, pre\-joining engagement).
* Coordinate with HR operations / onboarding for smooth joining – documentation, systems access, induction schedules.



  





 6\. ATS, Reporting \& Documentation
 


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate records in the ATS / trackers – including stages, notes, and communication history.
* Track and report your sourcing funnel metrics, including:



 Profiles identified → contacted → responded → screened → shortlisted → interviewed → offered → joined.
 


* Clearly mark candidates as sourced vs applied to help measure outbound impact.
* Share weekly updates with the Recruitment Manager on open roles, pipeline health, risks, and suggested corrective actions.



  





 7\. Market Intelligence \& Continuous Improvement
 


* Stay updated on tech recruitment trends, salary benchmarks, demand\-supply patterns, and competitor hiring.
* Share market feedback on challenging roles, skill shortages, or unrealistic expectations with the Recruitment Manager for calibration.
* Suggest improvements in JDs, search strategy, interview process, assessments, and candidate engagement based on your daily experience.



  





**Key Skills \& Requirements:** 



* Graduate (any discipline); specialization in HR / IT / related fields is an advantage.
* 2–5 years of experience in technical recruitment / IT staffing, preferably in a tech/startup or staffing / consulting environment.
* Strong comfort with hiring for tech roles (developers, data, QA, DevOps, product, etc.) and willingness to handle non\-tech/support roles as needed.
* Hands\-on experience in proactive sourcing using:
* LinkedIn (including advanced search techniques)
* Major job portals such as Indeed, Naukri, and others
* Boolean search and keyword strategies
* Good understanding of common tech skills and terminology (e.g Python, React, Node, microservices, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL/NoSQL, etc.).
* Structured, process\-oriented working style with strong documentation and follow\-through.
* Strong communication and candidate engagement skills; ability to build rapport quickly.
* Comfortable working with targets, SLAs, and multiple simultaneous open roles.
* High ownership, persistence, and ability to work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

**About GTSS (an SRM Tech Company)** 




 GTSS Minds (an SRM Tech Company) is a global staffing and talent solutions partner helping growing businesses source and onboard top talent across various technologies and domains.
 



 GTSS Minds, also known as GTSS Inc., is a US\-based IT staffing and recruiting company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Hamilton, New Jersey, USA. The company specializes in flexible staffing solutions for Fortune 500 companies, SMBs, and startups, offering contract, contract\-to\-hire, and full\-time hiring services.
 



 As part of the SRM Tech ecosystem, GTSS Minds focuses on delivering skilled professionals across areas such as Cloud, DevOps, AI/ML, Data Engineering, Software Development, QA Automation, Infrastructure, and Enterprise Technologies, helping clients scale teams quickly and efficiently.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and coordinating qualified candidates for contract, contract\-to\-hire, and full\-time opportunities with direct clients and implementation partners across the United States.
 



 The role requires strong experience in US staffing, hands\-on expertise with sourcing platforms such as Dice and LinkedIn, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced recruitment environment.

description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility\-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data\-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
   

  

**Come Join Our Team!**
* As part of our robust Rewards \& Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance\-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards


**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**
* The Denials Specialist (Accounts Receivable (“AR”) Specialist) is primarily responsible for analyzing collections, resolving non\-payables, and handling bill inquiries for more complex issues. AR Specialists are responsible for insurance payer follow\-up ensuring claims are paid according to client contracts. Complies with all applicable laws regarding billing standards.


**Essential Functions And Tasks**
* Follows up on claim rejections and denials to ensure appropriate reimbursement for our clients.
* Process assigned AR work lists provided by the manager in a timely manner.
* Write appeals using established guidelines to resolve claim denials with a goal of one contact resolution.
* Identified and resolved denied, non\-paid, and/or non\-adjudicated claims and billing issues due to coverage issues, medical record requests, and authorizations.
* Recommend accounts to be written off on Adjustment Request.
* Reports address and/or filing rule changes to the manager.
* Check the system for missing payments.
* Properly notates patient accounts.
* Review each piece of correspondence to determine specific problems.
* Research patient accounts.
* Reviews accounts and determines appropriate follow\-up actions (adjustments, letters, phone insurance, etc.).
* Processes and follows up on appeals. Files appeals on claim denials.
* Inbound/outbound calls may be required for follow\-up on accounts.
* Respond to insurance company claim inquiries.
* Communicates with insurance companies about the status of outstanding claims.
* Meet established production and quality standards as set by Ventra Health.
* Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* High School Diploma or GED.
* At least one (1\) year in the data entry field and one (1\) year in medical billing and claims resolution preferred.
* AAHAM and/or HFMA certification preferred.
* Experience with offshore engagement and collaboration desired.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Intermediate level knowledge of medical billing rules, such as coordination of benefits, modifiers, Medicare, and Medicaid, and understanding of EOBs.
* Become proficient in the use of billing software within 4 weeks and maintain proficiency.
* Ability to read, understand and apply state/federal laws, regulations, and policies.
* Ability to communicate with diverse personalities in a tactful, mature, and professional manner.
* Ability to remain flexible and work within a collaborative and fast\-paced environment.
* Basic use of a computer, telephone, internet, copier, fax, and scanner.
* Basic touch 10 key skills.
* Basic Math skills.
* Understand and comply with company policies and procedures.
* Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong time management and organizational skills.
* Strong knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel (pivot tables), and database software skills.


**Compensation**
* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job\-related reasons .
* This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentiv e bon us in accordance with company policies .

We will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, as needed, to assist them in performing essential job functions.

**A hybrid working model**

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around three days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

 We are looking for a detail\-oriented, highly organized Junior Recruiter based in Hyderabad (HYD) to provide operational and administrative support to our California (CA) Talent Acquisition team. This role is approximately 80% administrative/coordination\-focused \- covering offer management, background verification (BGV), and broader TA administrative support \- with the remaining time spent supporting recruiting activities as needed.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build a strong foundation in TA operations, process, and compliance, while getting hands\-on exposure to full\-cycle recruiting support for a fast\-paced global team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Administrative \& Operational Support:**
* Prepare, process, and track offer letters, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround in coordination with the CA TA team.
* Initiate, track, and follow up on background checks, flagging discrepancies or delays and coordinating resolution with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support the CA TA team with day\-to\-day coordination tasks, documentation, and process upkeep to keep hiring moving smoothly.
* Act as a reliable HYD\-based point of contact for CA\-based recruiters, ensuring handoffs and follow\-ups happen without delay despite time zone differences.


**Recruiting Support (as needed):**

* Comfortable working within structured processes (offer letters, BGV, ATS records) and following compliance and documentation standards.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication, with the ability to coordinate effectively with CA\-based stakeholders across time zones.
* Willingness to flex between administrative work and recruiting support based on team needs.
* Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (Greenhouse preferred) or willingness to learn quickly.
* Interest in building a long\-term career in Talent Acquisition, with eagerness to learn from a global TA team.

description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 The Talent Acquisition team supports hiring globally by partnering with a wide range of business areas and stakeholders to attract high\-calibre talent. The team operates in a fast\-paced, international environment where accuracy, collaboration and candidate experience are central to how we work. The TA Research team plays a critical role in A\&M’s growth by identifying and engaging talent for priority hiring campaigns. Working closely with recruiters, hiring managers and senior stakeholders, Researchers provide targeted market intelligence, well\-developed talent pipelines and help pinpoint the most suitable candidates for business\-critical roles. As a TA Researcher, you will focus on delivering high\-quality sourcing and talent mapping to support priority hiring across A\&M globally. As part of the TA Research team, you will work closely with recruiters and fellow Researchers to support search strategy, build targeted longlists, map relevant talent pools and engage high\-calibre candidates across a range of levels, functions and geographies. You will also share practical talent insights, including candidate availability and relevant competitor activity, to help inform search delivery.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* Deliver target company lists, talent maps, and executive pipelines across multiple business units and geographies using tools and sources such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Lusha, ContactOut, company websites, industry publications, conference attendee lists, executive biographies and broader web searches.
* Participate in search kick\-off meetings with recruiters and hiring managers, helping define target profiles, relevant organisations, sourcing channels and insight\-led research plans.
* Use AI tools, including Claude and Copilot, to support candidate research, market mapping and sourcing insights, helping improve targeting and reduce research cycle time.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports summarising talent market trends, company activity and candidate movement.
* Maintain market intelligence on M\&A activity, private equity transactions, competitor activity and wider talent trends, sharing clear insights.
* Partner closely with recruiters and researchers to ensure candidate data is accurate and consistent across recruiting systems and research tools.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in business management/HR or related discipline.
* 5\-7 years of talent research experience in an executive search setting, Agency, or equivalent in\-house function.
* Experience supporting Professional Services, Consulting, Finance, Tax or Private Equity executive roles preferred.
* Hands\-on experience identifying, mapping and researching executive talent using social networks, search engines, industry conferences, news sources, referrals and AI tools.
* Strong research and data organisation skills, with the ability to synthesise competitive landscape data and candidate intelligence into clear sourcing insights.
* Passion for finding niche and often “hard to find” profiles.
* High attention to detail, discretion and sound judgement when handling confidential searches and candidate information.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines and maintain high standards.
* Experience using research and recruiting tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, X\-Ray search, Lusha, ContactOut, AI tools (Claude, Copilot) and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).
* Experience with Power BI or other data visualization tools is a plus.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Placement Officer - Sourcing & Corporate Relations
description:
**Company:** 
 Boston Institute of Analytics (BIA)
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 1\+ Years
 



  





**About Boston Institute of Analytics** 




 The Boston Institute of Analytics is one of the top\-ranked international education and training institutes, headquartered in Boston, USA, with 107 campuses across 7\+ countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, South Africa, and India. BIA delivers industry\-leading programs across new\-age technical and non\-technical disciplines, helping students and professionals build future\-ready careers in the world's most in\-demand fields. Our programs emphasize practical learning, career\-focused training, and global certification pathways, enabling learners to develop the skills required to succeed in competitive global industries.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 BIA is looking for a proactive and execution\-focused
 **Associate \- Placements** 
 to join our Career \& Employability team in Mumbai. The role will be responsible for
 **sourcing relevant job opportunities for BIA students, building relationships with HRs and recruiters, coordinating hiring processes, maintaining the BIA CEC placement portal, and supporting students throughout the placement process** 
 .
 



 You will actively identify job openings across LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, company career pages, and other job platforms, connect with HRs and recruiters, understand their hiring requirements, and bring relevant opportunities to BIA students. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, good knowledge of recruitment processes, excellent follow\-up discipline, and the ability to manage multiple student and employer requirements simultaneously.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Job \& Opportunity Sourcing** 




 · Actively source relevant job openings for BIA students across
 **LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, company career pages, recruitment platforms, and other job portals** 
 .
 



 · Identify openings aligned with students' skills, courses, experience levels, locations, and career aspirations.
 



 · Build and maintain a database of relevant companies, recruiters, HR professionals, and active job openings.
 



 · Track new hiring requirements and identify recurring recruitment opportunities.
 



 · Research companies and industries to identify potential hiring partners for BIA.
 



  





**HR \& Recruiter Outreach** 




 · Connect with
 **HR Managers, Talent Acquisition teams, recruiters, hiring managers, and company representatives** 
 through calls, email, LinkedIn, and other professional channels.
 



 · Introduce BIA and its student talent pool to prospective employers.
 



 · Understand current and upcoming hiring requirements from companies.
 



 · Share relevant candidate profiles and CVs based on employer requirements.
 



 · Build and maintain strong relationships with HRs and recruiters.
 



 · Follow up consistently with companies regarding open positions, candidate shortlists, interviews, and selection status.
 



 · Work towards developing a strong network of active hiring companies.
 



  





**Placement Coordination** 




 · Coordinate the complete placement process between
 **students, BIA teams, and employers** 
 .
 



 · Share job opportunities with eligible students through the BIA CEC portal and other approved channels.
 



 · Collect and verify student applications for relevant positions.
 



 · Coordinate candidate shortlisting with recruiters and internal teams.
 



 · Schedule interviews, assessments, HR rounds, and other selection processes.
 



 · Track interview attendance, candidate status, feedback, selections, and offer status.
 



 · Follow up with both students and recruiters until the recruitment process is completed.
 



 · Maintain accurate records of all ongoing and completed placement activities.
 



  





**BIA CEC Portal Management** 




 · Manage and regularly update job opportunities, employer details, candidate applications, interview schedules, and placement status on the
 **BIA CEC portal** 
 .
 



 · Ensure all placement information is accurate and updated in a timely manner.
 



 · Upload new job openings and ensure relevant students are notified.
 



 · Maintain candidate application and selection records.
 



 · Track the complete placement pipeline through the portal.
 



 · Generate and maintain placement\-related reports and MIS as required.
 



  





**Student CV \& Profile Management** 




 · Coordinate with students to collect and update their latest CVs and professional profiles.
 



 · Ensure student CVs are aligned with relevant job descriptions and industry requirements.
 



 · Help students improve basic CV structure, formatting, keywords, and role\-specific positioning.
 



 · Maintain updated student CV databases.
 



 · Map students to relevant job opportunities based on their skills, experience, course background, and career goals.
 



 · Ensure students are placement\-ready before being recommended to employers.
 



  





**Student Placement Support** 




 · Communicate relevant job opportunities to eligible students.
 



 · Guide students on application processes, interview schedules, documentation, and employer requirements.
 



 · Coordinate interview preparation requirements with relevant internal teams.
 



 · Track student participation across placement drives and recruitment processes.
 



 · Follow up with students regarding interview attendance, results, offers, and joining status.
 



 · Maintain professional communication with students throughout the placement journey.
 



  





**Employer \& Placement Database** 




 · Build and continuously expand BIA's database of
 **companies, HR professionals, recruiters, hiring managers, job openings, and placement outcomes** 
 .
 



 · Maintain accurate records of employer interactions and hiring requirements.
 



 · Track companies that regularly hire from BIA.
 



 · Identify opportunities to develop long\-term hiring relationships.
 



 · Maintain a database of previous recruiters for future hiring requirements.
 



  





**Reporting \& MIS** 




 · Maintain daily and weekly placement activity reports.
 



 · Track metrics such as:
 



 o Jobs sourced
 



 o Companies contacted
 



 o HR/recruiter connections
 



 o Active hiring requirements
 



 o Candidates submitted
 



 o Interviews scheduled
 



 o Candidates shortlisted
 



 o Offers received
 



 o Students placed
 



 o Joining status
 



 · Share regular placement updates with the reporting manager.
 



 · Maintain accurate placement records and documentation.
 



  





**Key Skills Required** 




 · Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
 



 · Good understanding of recruitment and hiring processes.
 



 · Experience using
 **LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, and other job portals** 
 for sourcing opportunities.
 



 · Ability to identify relevant job opportunities and match them with candidate profiles.
 



 · Strong HR/recruiter outreach and relationship\-building skills.
 



 · Excellent follow\-up and coordination abilities.
 



 · Strong organisational and time\-management skills.
 



 · Comfortable handling multiple candidates, recruiters, and hiring processes simultaneously.
 



 · Good working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets.
 



 · Comfortable working with CRM, ATS, placement portals, or other recruitment platforms.
 



 · Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
 



 · Target\-oriented and proactive approach.
 



  





**Preferred Experience** 




 Candidates with
 **1\+ years of experience** 
 in any of the following areas are preferred:
 



 · Placement Operations
 



 · Campus Placements
 



 · Recruitment
 



 · Talent Acquisition
 



 · HR Recruitment
 



 · Corporate Relations
 



 · Employer Relations
 



 · Career Services
 



 · Recruitment Coordination
 



 · EdTech Placements
 



 · Staffing / Recruitment Consultancy
 



 · B2B Recruitment
 



 · Job Sourcing
 



 Experience in an
 **EdTech, recruitment firm, staffing company, training institute, university, or corporate HR environment** 
 will be an advantage.
 



  





**Educational Qualification** 




 · Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
 



 · MBA/PGDM in HR, Sales, Marketing, or Business Management is an added advantage but not mandatory.
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




 The Associate \- Placements will be expected to contribute towards measurable placement outcomes, including:
 



 · Number of relevant job openings sourced.
 



 · Number of new HR/recruiter connections established.
 



 · Number of active hiring companies.
 



 · Number of candidate profiles submitted.
 



 · Interview conversion and selection rates.
 



 · Number of students placed.
 



 · Placement turnaround time.
 



 · Student participation and application rates.
 



 · Accuracy and timeliness of BIA CEC portal updates.
 



 · Growth of BIA's employer and recruiter database.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 · Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and career\-development industry.
 



 · Direct exposure to recruiters, HR teams, hiring managers, and companies across industries.
 



 · Opportunity to build expertise in placements, recruitment, employer relations, and talent acquisition.
 



 · Performance\-driven career growth.
 



 · Supportive and collaborative work environment.
 



 · Opportunity to directly contribute to student career outcomes.
 



  





**Why Join BIA?** 




 · Work with an international education and training organisation.
 



 · Help students and professionals connect with real career opportunities.
 



 · Build relationships with companies and hiring teams across industries.
 



 · Gain hands\-on exposure to recruitment and corporate hiring.
 



 · Work at the intersection of
 **EdTech, talent acquisition, and career development** 
 .
 



 · Take ownership of the complete placement coordination process.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer** 




 Boston Institute of Analytics is committed to fair and inclusive hiring practices. All qualified candidates will be considered based on their skills, experience, communication abilities, and suitability for the role.

Human Capital Associate
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Human Capital Associate to join our growing team. In this role, you will support key HR functions across talent acquisition, HR operations, onboarding, employee engagement, and employee support. You will work closely with hiring managers and employees to ensure a seamless people experience while contributing to the growth of the organization.
   

  

 If you enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment, thrive on ownership, and are passionate about building great employee and candidate experiences, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities: \-**
**Talent Acquisition**
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for internship and full\-time roles across different functions.
* Source candidates through job portals, referrals, and other hiring channels.
* Screen applications, coordinate interviews, and ensure a smooth hiring process.
* Deliver a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Maintain recruitment data and hiring trackers.


**Employee Onboarding**
* Coordinate the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new hires.
* Ensure all pre\-joining and joining formalities are completed accurately and on time.
* Deliver a seamless onboarding experience while familiarizing new employees with company policies, processes, and culture.


**Human Resources Operations**
* Maintain accurate employee records, documentation, employment agreements, and human resources databases.
* Manage attendance, leave records, and employee data through the Human Resources Management System.
* Assist with payroll inputs and ensure smooth day\-to\-day human resources operations.


**Employee Engagement and Events**
* Support the planning and execution of employee engagement initiatives and company events.
* Coordinate logistics for both virtual and in\-office activities.
* Contribute ideas and initiatives that strengthen employee engagement and company culture.


**Employee Support and Query resolution**
* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries related to policies, attendance, leave, documentation, and human resources processes.
* Ensure timely resolution of employee concerns while maintaining confidentiality.
* Provide guidance and support throughout the employee lifecycle.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field.
* 1 to 2 years of experience in Human Resources, preferably in a startup or fast\-paced environment.
* Hands\-on experience in talent acquisition and human resources operations.
* Familiarity with any HRMS.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.


**What You Will Gain**
* Exposure to the complete employee lifecycle in a high\-growth startup.
* Opportunity to work closely with leadership and hiring managers.
* Ownership of key human resources initiatives and projects.
* A collaborative environment that encourages learning, innovation, and continuous growth.


**How We Work**
* We use Microsoft Teams for daily communication, including standups and team meetings.
* Our culture values open discussion, ownership, and a founder’s mindset.
* We prioritize exceptional design, UI/UX, thorough documentation, clear to\-do lists, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Team bonding is encouraged through bi\-monthly townhalls, destressing sessions with a certified healer, and biannual company retreats.
* We offer a fully remote workplace, comprehensive health insurance, attractive equity options for top performers, mental health consultations, company\-sponsored upskilling courses, designated growth hours, 40 hours annually for community causes, and access to a financial advisor.
* Wobot is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
**Description:** 




  





 Talent Solutions RPO is seeking an experienced
 **Technology Recruiter** 
 to lead end\-to\-end talent acquisition initiatives for a portfolio of technology roles. This position plays a critical role in partnering with hiring managers and business leaders to identify, attract, and hire top technical talent in a highly competitive market.
 



  





 The successful candidate will combine deep recruiting expertise, market intelligence, and strong stakeholder management skills to deliver exceptional hiring outcomes. This role requires a proactive talent advisor who can influence hiring decisions, develop innovative sourcing strategies, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience while driving recruitment excellence across the organization.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  





 As a Technology Recruiter, you will be responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle while serving as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders. Key responsibilities include:
 



  




* Partner with hiring managers and leadership teams to develop effective hiring strategies aligned with business objectives and workforce planning needs.
* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment activities, including talent sourcing, candidate identification, screening, assessment, interview management, offer negotiation, and onboarding support.
* Build and maintain robust talent pipelines for current and future technology hiring requirements across multiple skill domains.
* Utilize market insights, competitive intelligence, and talent mapping techniques to identify and engage high\-caliber technical talent.
* Provide consultative guidance to hiring managers on talent availability, compensation trends, interview best practices, and hiring decisions.
* Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through consistent communication, timely feedback, and a professional recruitment process.
* Leverage data, recruiting metrics, and reporting to drive process improvements and influence hiring outcomes.
* Collaborate with Human Resources, Talent Partners, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on hiring priorities and recruitment strategies.
* Champion diversity and inclusion initiatives by developing inclusive sourcing strategies and diverse candidate pipelines.
* Support employer branding efforts and promote the organization's value proposition to attract top\-tier technology professionals.
* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies, processes, and applicable employment regulations throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and become a trusted talent advisor capable of influencing and driving hiring success.



  





**Required Skills:** 




  





 • 8\+ years Proven success in full cycle recruitment utilizing mature account management skills.
 



 • Experience and comfort partnering \& consulting at all levels of leadership.
 



 • Desire and capability to work with other Talent Partners to drive recruitment solutions across a wide variety of openings.
 



 • Possess an ability to be flexible and provide the right solution at the right time.
 



 • Success in developing inclusive pipelines.
 



 • Success in guiding, consulting and educating hiring managers on hiring best practices.
 



 • Experience in guiding managers on use of corporate services such as relocation and immigration.
 



 • Stay informed and connected to external factors and market conditions that impact our ability to attract quality hires.
 



 • Develop knowledge and understanding of the culture, products and industry \- Support internal processes/requirements.
 



 • Bachelor’s or equivalent experience, Masters in HR/OD or MBA is a plus.
 



 • This role will support and grow the Product Engineering function. 5\+ years of technical recruiting experience in a similar environment is required Qualifications.
 



 • Creating opportunities to influence external Product Engineering talent for long range hiring goals
 



 • Influencing hiring decisions based on recruiting expertise and shared business goals
 



 • Provide hiring insights through metrics and analysis reporting to business and TA leaders
 



 • Develop and drive recruiting strategy for product engineering across business units
 



 • Develop and drive an assessment strategy with each hiring manager
 



 • Lead the offer process and provide guidance to the hiring leader \& HR Business Partner to arrive at competitive and equitable compensation packages
 



 • Understanding business needs and leverage the business strategy in your communication efforts and recruiting strategy to win talent
 



 • Collaborate, partner across teams and mentor junior recruiters.

title: Lead Recruiter - Tech & Leadership Hiring
description:
**About the role** 




 We're hiring a Lead Recruiter to own senior and business\-critical hiring at SkilloVilla. This is a hands\-on role with team responsibility. You'll close niche technical and leadership mandates yourself while guiding a small team of recruiters and partnering directly with founders and function heads on how we hire.
 



**What you'll own** 



* Drive end\-to\-end hiring for senior IC, technical, and leadership roles — from intake and market mapping to offer negotiation and closure
* Lead and mentor a team of recruiters: goal setting, pipeline reviews, quality of shortlists, and capability building
* Partner with hiring managers as an advisor, not a coordinator — challenge role definitions, set realistic hiring plans, and manage expectations on timelines and compensation
* Build proactive talent pipelines through direct sourcing, referrals, industry mapping, and community networks
* Own hiring metrics: time\-to\-fill, offer\-to\-join ratio, quality of hire, source effectiveness — and use the data to fix what's leaking
* Improve interview processes, structured evaluation, scorecards, and candidate experience across the funnel
* Manage employer branding inputs and drive closures in competitive offer situations



**What we're looking for** 



* 5–6 years in talent acquisition, with a strong track record in technical and leadership hiring
* Proven team handling experience — you've managed, reviewed, and coached recruiters
* Demonstrable closures of senior and hard\-to\-fill roles
* Strong direct sourcing skills across LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, referrals, and networks
* Confident stakeholder management with senior leadership; comfortable pushing back with data
* Sharp assessment ability — you can judge depth beyond the résumé
* Experience with ATS platforms and hiring dashboards



**Good to have** 



* Exposure to hiring in \[product / startup / EdTech / SaaS]
* Experience setting up hiring processes from scratch or scaling a team quickly
* Comfort with compensation benchmarking and offer structuring

Job Title: Associate Sales Consultant Health Insurance (Freshers Welcome) Industry: Insurance / BFSI Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent Experience: 0-6 Months Salary: 2,60,000 – 3,50,000 CTC per annum + Incentives Location: Logic Infotech, 2nd Floor, Sector-59, Noida (Opposite Metro Station) Working Days: 6 Days/Week, Roster-based Week Off Shift: Day Shift, Fixed Timings 
 About the Company Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Ltd. is a joint venture between True North, one of India's leading private equity firms, and Bupa, a global healthcare group with over 60 years of experience and 29 million customers across 190+ countries. Niva Bupa is on a mission to become India's most admired health insurance company by helping customers live healthier, more secure lives. This is your opportunity to start your sales career with a globally-backed, fast-growing brand in the health insurance space. 
 Why This Role Is Perfect for Freshers Starting your career in sales can be intimidating — that's why this role is built differently: You will never make a cold call . Every lead you speak to has already shown interest in our health insurance products. You get a fixed salary from day one, so your income isn't dependent purely on incentives while you learn the ropes. You'll receive on-the-job training and mentorship to build your sales and communication skills from scratch. Backed by a trusted global brand — a strong foundation to launch your career in insurance/BFSI sales. 
 Key Responsibilities Connect with pre-qualified, interested customers (leads shared by the company) to explain and sell Niva Bupa's health insurance plans Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable health insurance products Guide customers through policy features, benefits, premiums, and the purchase process Achieve daily/monthly sales targets and contribute to team goals Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and follow-ups Ensure a positive customer experience in every interaction to support long-term retention 
 What We're Looking For Graduates, Postgraduates, or MBA freshers (0-6 months of experience) Good spoken English and strong interpersonal/convincing skills A confident, energetic, and presentable personality Willingness to learn and work in a target-driven environment Ability to stay composed and motivated under pressure Prior exposure to telesales, BPO, or insurance sales is a plus — but not required 
 What You'll Get Fixed monthly salary + attractive, uncapped incentive structure Additional confidential monetary incentives for top performers Statutory benefits: ESIC, PF, and Gratuity Group Insurance Cover for employees Fixed day shift with a predictable 6-day work week Career growth path within a reputed, globally-backed insurance company Interview Process HR Screening (Telephonic/In-person) Communication & Sales Aptitude Assessment Operations/Team Leader Round Offer Rollout

title: Hr Executive And Recruiter
description: About the Role We are looking for a proactive and organized HR Executive to join our Group HR team. The role will primarily focus on end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition across multiple business verticals within the Group, along with supporting various HR operations and employee engagement activities. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, good sourcing capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple requirements simultaneously. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Primary Responsibility Manage end-to-end recruitment for assigned positions across Group Companies. Understand manpower requirements and prepare/coordinate Job Descriptions (JDs) with the respective departments. Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, recruitment agencies, and other channels . Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate assessments. Conduct preliminary HR interviews and coordinate technical/functional interviews with hiring managers. Maintain regular follow-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Coordinate interview schedules and ensure timely feedback from interview panels. Manage candidate negotiation and offer coordination in consultation with the reporting manager. Coordinate offer release, pre-joining follow-ups, and joining formalities . Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and provide regular recruitment MIS and status reports . Build and maintain a pipeline of suitable candidates for recurring and critical positions. Support bulk hiring, campus recruitment, walk-in drives, and other hiring initiatives whenever required. Ensure positions are closed within the agreed Turnaround Time (TAT) . 2. HR Operations Support day-to-day HR operations across Group Companies. Coordinate employee joining, onboarding, induction, and exit formalities . Maintain and update employee records and HR documentation. Support attendance, leave, payroll inputs, and other employee-related HR processes. Assist in maintaining personnel files and ensuring HR documentation is complete and up to date. Coordinate issuance of HR-related letters and documents such as appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, relieving letters, etc. Assist in implementing HR policies and procedures. 3. Employee Engagement & HR Support Support employee engagement activities, events, celebrations, and internal initiatives. Assist in employee communication and coordination on HR-related matters. Support employee grievance handling and escalate concerns to the reporting manager where required. Assist in organizing training and development programs. Support performance management and appraisal-related activities. 4. HR MIS & Documentation Maintain accurate recruitment and HR databases. Prepare regular Recruitment MIS, joining reports, hiring status reports, and other HR reports . Track recruitment metrics such as: Open Positions Profiles Sourced Profiles Shortlisted Interviews Scheduled Offers Released Offers Accepted Positions Closed Time-to-Hire Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of employee and candidate information. 5. Other HR Responsibilities Coordinate with department heads and business teams regarding manpower requirements. Assist the HR team in implementing new HR processes and initiatives. Support statutory compliance and other HR activities as assigned. Perform any other HR-related responsibilities assigned by the reporting manager. Required Skills & Competencies Strong communication and interpersonal skills . Good knowledge of recruitment and sourcing techniques . Ability to effectively screen and assess candidates. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously. Good negotiation and candidate management skills. Strong organizational and time-management abilities. Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets, MS Office, and recruitment platforms . Ability to maintain recruitment trackers and prepare HR MIS. Good understanding of basic HR processes and practices. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline . MBA/PGDM in Human Resources will be an added advantage. Preferred Experience 1–3 years of experience in HR / Recruitment / Talent Acquisition. Experience handling multiple vacancies across different functions or business verticals will be preferred. Candidates with experience in a group/company environment or multi-industry recruitment will be an advantage.

description:
**General Information** 




**Role Title:** 
 Senior Recruiter / Senior Talent Partner
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka (Onsite / Hybrid)
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time, permanent
 



**Hiring Timeline:** 
 Immediate
 



**Reports To:** 
 Talent Acquisition Lead
 



**Existing Vacancy:** 
 Yes
 



**Application Deadline:** 
 Open until Filled
 



**Shift Timings:** 
 2:00 PM \- 11:00 PM IST
 



**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):** 




 Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high\-performance logistics operations.
 



 We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real\-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end\-to\-end supply chain execution.
 



 Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time\-to\-value and reduce delivery risk.
   





**Role Overview:** 



* The Senior Recruiter / Senior Talent Partner is responsible for delivering complex, high\-impact hiring while elevating the overall effectiveness of Fulfillment IQ's recruiting function.
* This role goes beyond filling roles. Senior Recruiters are expected to own hard\-to\-fill, specialist, or senior hires, improve hiring quality, speed, and decision discipline, and surface data\-backed insights that help the Talent Acquisition Lead optimize strategy, process, and capacity.
* This is a senior individual contributor role with significant influence, broad stakeholder exposure, and a clear path toward talent acquisition leadership.



**Mandate:** 



* Deliver successful outcomes on complex and high\-priority roles
* Improve recruiting quality, consistency, and decision\-making
* Act as a trusted hiring partner to senior stakeholders
* Use data and market insight to strengthen hiring strategy and execution



**Must Have:** 



* 7\-10 years of full\-cycle recruiting experience in consulting, technology, or services\-led environments
* Demonstrated success hiring for complex, niche, or senior roles
* Strong sourcing, assessment, and closing capability
* Proven ability to influence hiring managers and guide decisions
* Comfort working across regions, time zones, and seniority levels



**Market \& Domain Expertise:** 



* We are looking for an experienced recruiter with strong exposure to both the US and Canada markets.



**The ideal candidate should have:** 



* Hands\-on experience hiring across North America
* Strong understanding of US employment structures and tax terms (W2, C2C, 1099\)
* Working knowledge of work visa processes and compliance
* Familiarity with cross\-border hiring dynamics and talent availability



**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience hiring in supply chain, logistics, or enterprise technology domains
* Exposure to workforce planning or recruiting analytics
* Experience coaching or mentoring recruiters



**Key Responsibilities:**




**Complex \& High\-Impact Hiring** 



* Own full\-cycle recruiting for senior, niche, or hard\-to\-fill roles
* Lead intake sessions to define success profiles, competencies, and evaluation criteria
* Influence role scoping, leveling, and success metrics during intake based on market realities
* Open and post new job requisitions assigned to you across various hiring platforms and job boards
* Design sourcing strategies that balance speed, quality, and long\-term pipeline health



**Assessment \& Decision Quality** 



* Conduct structured interviews and guide hiring teams on consistent evaluation
* Facilitate debriefs and drive clear, timely hiring decisions
* Identify and resolve misalignment, bias, or indecision in the interview process



**Stakeholder Partnership** 



* Act as a trusted partner to senior hiring managers and functional leaders
* Advise on market realities, trade\-offs, and hiring feasibility
* Escalate risks, delays, or systemic issues to the TA Lead with proposed solutions
* Format Resumes for client‑specific requirements and coordinate with hiring managers to schedule client interview rounds (for client staff augmentation only)



**Process \& Performance Improvement**



* Analyze funnel performance, stage conversion, and candidate drop\-off
* Identify patterns impacting quality, speed, or candidate experience
* Partner with the TA Lead to test and implement process improvements



**Team Enablement** 



* Coach and support Recruiters through informal mentorship and calibration
* Share best practices in sourcing, interviewing, and closing
* Contribute to hiring playbooks, interview guides, and role templates



**Vendor Partnership \& Vendor Management:** 



* Act as the primary SPOC for external vendors, ensuring alignment on role requirements, hiring timelines, and evaluation criteria
* Share job specifications and coordinate resume submissions, interview scheduling, and candidate progress across stages
* Partner with hiring managers, the Talent Intelligence team, and external recruiters to secure offers from successful candidates



**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:** 




**30 Days In**



* Build a deep understanding of Fulfillment IQ's business, roles, and hiring priorities
* Take ownership of assigned complex or priority roles
* Establish trust with hiring managers and the TA team



**60 Days In**



* Demonstrate consistent progress and momentum on complex hires
* Improve interview quality and decision speed on assigned roles
* Begin surfacing funnel insights and improvement opportunities



**90 Days In**



* Successfully close multiple high\-impact or difficult roles
* Contribute measurable improvements to hiring efficiency or quality
* Be recognized as a trusted advisor by hiring leaders and TA leadership



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):** 



* Closure rate on complex or priority roles
* Time\-to\-hire and stage aging on assigned requisitions
* Time\-to\-fill on assigned requisitions
* Interview\-to\-offer and offer acceptance rates
* Hiring manager satisfaction
* Contribution to funnel and process improvements
* Probation Pass Rate
* Preboarding Candidate Satisfaction survey scores



**Why You'll Love Working Here:** 




 At Fulfillment IQ, we don't just build supply chain solutions; we build long\-term careers.
   

 We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you're leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.
 



 We operate with a high\-trust, high\-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.
 



 Here's what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:
 



**Work That Matters**
 You'll help solve real operational challenges that directly impact global commerce, customer experience, and supply chain performance.
 



**Career Growth That Matters**
 We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning — supporting both vertical growth and long\-term career progression.
 



**Flexibility to Thrive**
 We support remote and hybrid work models, flexible schedules, and trust our teams to manage their time responsibly.
 



**We Celebrate Impact**
 From project wins to personal milestones, we recognize contribution, celebrate progress, and value consistency over heroics.
 



**A Collaborative Culture**
 You'll work alongside experienced consultants, engineers, product leaders, and commercial professionals who value ownership, transparency, and high standards.
   





**Perks you'll appreciate:** 




**Health and Wellness** 



* Comprehensive group medical insurance for you and your family, in line with local practice


* Employee wellness programs where applicable



**Time Off** 



* Competitive paid time off, sick leave, and public holidays


* Flexible leave policies that respect local labour standards



**Retirement and Financial Security** 



* Statutory retirement and social security contributions (Employees' Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance where applicable, and gratuity)


* Employee stock options (ESOP), where applicable



**Professional Growth** 



* Dedicated learning and development budget, with support for skills, leadership, and career progression



**Flexible Work** 



* Remote and hybrid work options, flexible hours aligned to role and client needs



**Additional Perks** 



* Equipment and workstation allowances, internet and business travel reimbursements, team events and offsites



**Work Authorization:** 




 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India. 
 



**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring:** 




 FIQ uses artificial intelligence to assist in the screening, assessment, and shortlisting of applications for this position, including features within our applicant tracking system. AI supports human reviewers and does not make hiring decisions on its own. Final hiring decisions are made by FIQ personnel. If you have questions about how AI is used in this process, contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com. 
 



**Accommodations:** 




 FIQ is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Consistent with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, accommodations are available on request at any stage of recruitment and assessment. Contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com and we will work with you to meet your needs. 
 



**Candidate Privacy:** 




 Your personal information is collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with FIQ's Candidate Privacy Notice, available at here, and in accordance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. This includes the use of AI\-assisted screening described above and cross\-border storage or processing that may occur in the United States. By applying, you acknowledge this notice. Questions: hr@fulfillmentiq.com. 
 



**Equal Opportunity:** 




 Fulfillment IQ is a people\-first company built on trust, collaboration, and ownership. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high\-performing workplace. We provide equal opportunity in line with the Constitution of India and consider all qualified applicants without regard to religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable Indian law. 
 



**Safe and Respectful Workplace:** 




 FIQ maintains a safe and respectful workplace and complies with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH). We have a constituted Internal Committee to receive and address complaints, and every employee is covered by our anti\-harassment policy from day one.

title: People Operations Admin @ Resonate CX
description:
**People Operations Admin** 





 Recruitment  •  People Operations  •  Administration  •  Global Team Support
 




**About Resonate** 





 Resonate is an Australian customer experience (CX) software company. For a decade, we’ve helped organisations listen to their customers and act on what they hear. Today, we work across global markets, supported by a team spanning Australia, India, the Philippines, the UK and the US.
 





 We’re at an exciting point in our journey — growing, investing in our product, and building the kind of company people are proud to be part of. This is a brand\-new role, created to help us do exactly that.
 




**The Role** 





 As our People Operations Admin, you’ll play an important role in keeping our People Operations running smoothly and helping create a great employee experience across Resonate.
 





 This is a hands\-on role covering recruitment, people administration, onboarding, employee experience, culture initiatives and day\-to\-day People \& Culture support. You’ll work closely with the People \& Culture team, managers and employees across our global locations.
 




**What You’ll Do** 




**Recruitment** 



* Support recruitment activities including job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination and candidate communication.



**People Operations \& Administration** 



* Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems and documentation.
* Support day\-to\-day People \& Culture administration, reporting and employee lifecycle processes.
* Coordinate onboarding from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, including introductions, systems access and resources.



**People \& Culture Initiatives** 



* Support employee engagement, recognition, surveys, culture initiatives and internal People \& Culture communications.
* Help coordinate company events, team activities and employee programs.



**Global Team Support** 



* Support employees across Australia, India, the Philippines, the UK and the US.
* Coordinate activities across locations and time zones and work with local providers and partners.
* Help create connection, consistency and a positive employee experience across our distributed teams.



  





**About You** 





 You’re organised, approachable and genuinely enjoy helping people. You don’t need to know everything about HR — what matters most is that you’re curious, proactive and eager to learn.
 



* 1–3 years’ experience in HR, People \& Culture, People Operations, administration, recruitment or a similar role.
* Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive approach, good problem\-solving skills and willingness to take ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Experience using HR systems and Microsoft Office/365\.
* Ability to work confidently with AI tools and an interest in smarter ways of working.
* Basic graphic design skills.
* Event planning or coordination experience is a nice\-to\-have.
* Experience working with distributed or global teams is an advantage.



**What We Offer** 



* Broad exposure to People \& Culture and the opportunity to build your HR career.
* Real ownership and the opportunity to make an impact from day one.
* Exposure to leaders and teams across a growing global business.
* Learning and development opportunities.
* A supportive and collaborative team environment.
* The opportunity to grow with Resonate as the business continues to evolve.
* Opportunities to travel and experience different parts of the world.



**Why Resonate?** 





 At Resonate, we believe great customer experiences start with great employee experiences. We’re a growing, global team that values collaboration, curiosity, ownership and having a bit of fun along the way.
 





 If you’re looking for a role where you can learn, contribute and make a real difference to the employee experience, we’d love to hear from you.
 




**How to Apply** 





 If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and tell us a little about yourself and why you’d be a great addition to the Resonate team.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
Technical Recruiter
 



  





 Location: Hyderabad, India
 



 Work Model: On\-site
 



 Company: Linx
 



 Experience: 3–6 years
 



  





 About Linx
 



  





 Linx helps companies build and manage teams globally through Employer of Record (EOR), Global Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and Global Capability Center (GCC) solutions.
 



  





 As we continue to scale our global recruiting operations, we are looking for a Technical Recruiter who knows how to find exceptional talent — not simply process applications.
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 We are looking for a hands\-on Technical Recruiter who can own technical searches from requirement intake through offer acceptance.
 



  





 You should be comfortable recruiting across:
 



  





 \* Software Engineering
 



 \* Data \& Analytics
 



 \* AI / Machine Learning
 



 \* Cloud \& DevOps
 



 \* Cybersecurity
 



 \* Product \& Technical Program Management
 



 \* QA / Automation
 



 \* Enterprise Applications
 



  





 This is a delivery\-focused role. You’ll work closely with hiring managers and recruiting leadership to understand requirements, develop sourcing strategies, engage passive candidates, and close positions quickly without compromising quality.
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 



  





 Own the search. Understand the role beyond the job description — technology stack, seniority, compensation, team structure and what actually makes someone successful.
 



  





 Source proactively. Build pipelines through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, databases and creative sourcing techniques rather than relying on inbound applications.
 



  





 Evaluate technical talent. Conduct strong recruiter screens and understand technology well enough to distinguish genuine hands\-on experience from keywords on a résumé.
 



  





 Manage the entire recruiting lifecycle. Sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate engagement, feedback, offer negotiation and closure.
 



  





 Partner with hiring managers. Challenge requirements when necessary, recalibrate searches quickly and provide real market intelligence.
 



  





 Recruit globally. Support technical hiring across India, the US and other international markets based on client requirements.
 



  





 Maintain recruiting discipline. Keep ATS data accurate and provide clear visibility into submissions, interviews, offers, closures and bottlenecks.
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 \* 3–6 years of hands\-on technical recruiting experience
 



 \* Strong experience sourcing passive technical candidates
 



 \* Good understanding of modern technology roles and terminology
 



 \* Strong LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean search skills
 



 \* Ability to manage multiple open requirements simultaneously
 



 \* Excellent written and verbal communication
 



 \* Strong candidate assessment and negotiation skills
 



 \* Experience supporting US or international technical hiring strongly preferred
 



 \* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven environment
 



  





 How We Measure Success
 



  





 We care about outcomes, not résumé volume.
 



  





 Quality of submission → Interview conversion → Offer conversion → Time to fill → Joining ratio → Hiring\-manager/client satisfaction
 



  





 Sending 50 average profiles isn’t more successful than sending 10 excellent ones.
 



  





 A Note About Our Interview Process
 



  





 At Linx, we’re building the future of recruiting — and we believe our own candidates should experience the technology we’re creating.
 



  





 The first step in the interview process for this role is a Lexy AI interview.
 



  





 It’s an opportunity for us to learn more about your experience, approach to recruiting and how you think, while also giving you firsthand experience with the AI recruiting technology that is becoming part of how we work.
 



  





 We’re looking for recruiters who are curious about technology and comfortable working in an environment where AI and human judgment work together.
 



  





 If participating in an AI interview isn’t something you’re comfortable with or interested in, we completely respect that. This particular opportunity, however, may not be the right fit, and we’d encourage you to consider that before applying.
 



  





 Who Will Do Well Here
 



  





 Someone who is curious, persistent and commercially minded.
 



  





 You enjoy difficult searches. You know how to find candidates other recruiters can’t. You follow up relentlessly, communicate well and understand that candidate experience matters.
 



  





 When someone says:
 



  





 “We’ve been trying to fill this position for three months.”
 



  





 Your instinct is:
 



  





 “Give me the requirement.”
 



  





 If that’s how you recruit — and you’re excited about how AI is changing our industry — we’d like to meet you.

**In\-Office Expectation:** This role is expected to work onsite five days per week, supporting a highly collaborative, in\-person team environment.

You’ll get hands\-on experience with the systems, processes, data, and AI\-enabled tools behind a modern recruiting function, while contributing ideas that make hiring simpler and more effective. Along the way, you’ll partner with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, global TA Operations, and the broader People Team, gaining exposure to the way a global Talent Acquisition team operates across India, the United States, Mexico, and Europe.



**What You’ll Do**



**Recruiting Coordination**

**Talent Acquisition Operations**

* Support updates to workflows, templates, candidate communications, and recruiting documentation.
* Review AI\-generated content for accuracy, relevance, and quality before use.
* Learn how AI and automation can be applied responsibly within Talent Acquisition.


**Projects, Reporting \& Documentation**


* Support Talent Acquisition projects, recruiting programs, and process improvement initiatives.
* Assist with recruiting reports, trackers, dashboards, and basic data analysis.
* Help create and update SOPs, playbooks, process documentation, and recruiting resources.
* Support employer branding, recruiting events, campus or early\-career initiatives, and other Talent Acquisition programs as needed.
* Assist with ad hoc TA projects and cross\-functional initiatives based on team and business priorities.


✨ **Candidate Experience, Employer Brand \& Local Engagement**


* Provide timely and thoughtful communication to candidates throughout the recruiting process.
* Help create a consistent and positive candidate experience from scheduling through onboarding.
* Support pre\-onboarding engagement and candidate touchpoints prior to joining.
* Represent Nextiva professionally when interacting with candidates and external talent.
* Support local employer branding, recruiting events, social media initiatives, and talent attraction activities as needed.
* Assist with employee engagement, culture\-building, and People Team activities where appropriate.
* Support other local and regional Talent Acquisition or People Team initiatives based on business needs.


**What We’re Looking For**


* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree, Master's degree, or equivalent experience.
* Interest in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting Operations, or People Operations.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Comfortable working with calendars, spreadsheets, documents, and collaboration tools.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar tools personally, academically, or professionally.
* Curiosity and willingness to use approved AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar technologies to support research, communication, documentation, and day\-to\-day productivity.
* Willingness to learn new recruiting systems, tools, and processes.
* Ability to work collaboratively with individuals across teams, countries, and time zones.
* Ability and willingness to work outside standard business hours as needed to support recruiting activities, interview coordination, and TA Operations in a global environment.
* High level of professionalism and discretion when handling candidate and confidential information.
* Able to attend occasional meetings outside of normal business hours with Global team members as needed.


**Nice to Have**


* Previous internship, work, volunteer, or academic experience related to Recruiting.
* Familiarity with Greenhouse or another Applicant Tracking System.
* Experience coordinating meetings, interviews, events, or calendars.
* Exposure to Excel, reporting, data tracking, or process documentation.
