Job Description – Corporate Recruiter

**Company:** Turabit Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Ahmedabad – Shilp Epitome, Sindhu Bhavan Road  
**Position:** Corporate Recruiter  
**Experience:** Minimum 1\+ Year  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Location:** On\-site  
**Shift:** Day Shift – 10:30 AM to 7:30 PM  
**Working Days:** Monday to Friday

**About Turabit Solutions**

Turabit Solutions is a technology\-driven organization focused on delivering innovative technology and AI\-enabled solutions. We are looking for a dedicated and career\-oriented **Corporate Recruiter** who can take ownership of the recruitment process and contribute to building a strong and high\-performing organization.

This role is ideal for an HR professional who has **at least 1 year of experience in US IT Services, US IT Staffing, or a similar technology\-driven environment** and is looking to build a long\-term career in Corporate HR and Talent Acquisition.

**Position Overview**

The Corporate Recruiter will be responsible for managing and executing the **end\-to\-end recruitment process** for corporate and technology positions. The person should have a strong understanding of recruitment fundamentals, excellent follow\-up and coordination skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work with a sense of urgency.

We are looking for someone who is **dedicated, disciplined, time\-bound, proactive and willing to go the extra mile** to achieve hiring objectives.

The candidate should also be comfortable using **AI tools and modern recruitment technologies** to improve sourcing, screening, communication, productivity, and overall recruitment efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**  
1\. End\-to\-End Recruitment

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from understanding hiring requirements to candidate onboarding.
* Work closely with hiring managers and department heads to understand manpower requirements and job specifications.
* Prepare and publish accurate job descriptions on appropriate job portals and professional networks.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, databases, social media, and other relevant channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate assessments.
* Conduct preliminary HR interviews and evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, communication, attitude, and organizational fit.
* Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds with relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain regular communication and follow\-up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Manage offer discussions, salary negotiations, documentation, and joining formalities.
* Ensure a smooth candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.

2\. US IT Staffing / Technology Recruitment Understanding

* Leverage previous exposure to **US IT Services / US IT Staffing** to understand technology roles, candidate profiles, and recruitment terminology.
* Understand common technology skill sets and be able to identify relevant candidates from resumes.
* Develop and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for recurring and critical positions.
* Build relationships with potential candidates for future hiring requirements.

3\. Corporate HR \& Recruitment Process

* Maintain proper recruitment records, trackers, interview schedules, candidate status, and hiring reports.
* Ensure recruitment activities are completed within defined timelines.
* Follow established HR policies, recruitment SOPs, and approval processes.
* Maintain confidentiality of candidate and employee information.
* Coordinate with HR and management for joining, documentation, background verification, and onboarding activities.
* Support other HR initiatives as required.

4\. AI \& Recruitment Technology

* Use **AI tools and recruitment technologies** to work smarter, faster, and more efficiently.
* Explore practical applications of AI for:
* Resume screening and shortlisting
* Candidate sourcing
* Job description creation and optimization
* Interview question generation
* Candidate communication
* Recruitment reporting and analysis
* Recruitment documentation
* Market and talent research
* Continuously identify ways to improve recruitment productivity through automation, AI, and digital tools.
* Stay updated with emerging AI\-based HR and recruitment technologies.

Key Skills \& Competencies

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

* Strong understanding of **core recruitment and HR processes**.
* Minimum **1 year of experience in US IT Services, US IT Staffing, IT recruitment, or a similar technology environment**.
* Excellent sourcing and candidate screening skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good understanding of recruitment lifecycle and interview coordination.
* Strong follow\-up and candidate relationship management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Professional discipline and a positive attitude.
* Ability to work within deadlines and meet recruitment targets.
* Proactive approach with a willingness to **go the extra mile** when required.
* Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and recruitment tools.
* Basic understanding or hands\-on exposure to **AI tools for recruitment** will be an advantage.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a professional who:

* Is **serious about building a long\-term career in Corporate HR and Talent Acquisition**.
* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.
* Is highly **dedicated, detail\-oriented, disciplined, and time\-bound**.
* Understands that recruitment requires consistent follow\-up, urgency, and persistence.
* Can work independently while collaborating effectively with managers and teams.
* Is willing to learn, adapt, and continuously improve.
* Has a **“can\-do” attitude** and is willing to go beyond routine responsibilities to achieve hiring objectives.
* Wants to develop into a strong HR professional and eventually take on broader HR responsibilities.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR will be an advantage.
* 1\+ year of relevant recruitment experience.
* Prior experience with **US IT Staffing / US IT Services / Technology recruitment** is preferred.
* Experience using job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to ATS/HRMS/recruitment tracking systems is an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or other AI\-based recruitment/productivity tools is preferred.

Career Growth

This position is intended for a candidate who wants to build a **long\-term career in Corporate HR**.

Based on performance, capability, and demonstrated ownership, the role can provide opportunities to grow into areas such as:

**Corporate Recruiter → Senior Corporate Recruiter → Talent Acquisition Specialist / Lead → HR Generalist / HRBP / Talent Acquisition Manager**

Why Join Turabit Solutions?

* Opportunity to work in a technology and AI\-focused organization.
* Exposure to modern recruitment practices and AI\-enabled HR processes.
* Opportunity to work closely with management and business leaders.
* Strong learning and career\-development opportunity in Corporate HR.
* Five\-day working week – Monday to Friday.
* Day shift: **10:30 AM to 7:30 PM**.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (Non-Tech)
description:
About Lokal :
   

  

 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
   

  

 This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight \- when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a
 **house of focused apps,** 
 many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the
 **Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts** 
 they've always deserved.
   

  

 We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
   

  

* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) Advisory Services \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more


 Under the hood, Lokal is a
 **discovery and access platform** 
 : local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight\+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
   

  

 This is the story new teammates walk into:
   

  

 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre —
 **access changes lives** 
 .
 **We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.**
 We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.
   

  

**Role Overview :**
 As a
 **Recruiter at Lokal** 
 , your primary objective will be to effectively screen and prepare candidates for client interviews. Your role is crucial in ensuring a seamless recruitment process, from initial outreach to successful candidate placement. You will be responsible for reaching out to a large pool of candidates daily, scheduling interviews, and maintaining high standards of communication and data accuracy.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Candidate Outreach: Ensure that at least 10 candidates are lined up for client interviews each day.
* Interview Completion: Ensure that a minimum of 5 interviews are conducted daily with shortlisted candidates.
* Selection Rate: Achieve at least 2 candidate selections per day from the interviews conducted
* Joining Rate: Secure at least 1 confirmed candidate joining per day from the selections made.
* Profile Completion: Complete and document candidate profiles daily.
* Screening and Scheduling: Screen candidates based on client\-specific requirements and schedule interviews accordingly. Use Forms provided by the company to collect and organize candidate information.
* Candidate Communication: Maintain consistent and proactive communication with candidates to ensure they attend scheduled interviews. Provide post\-selection support to candidates to enhance their onboarding experience.
* Data Management: Maintain up\-to\-date records of candidate interactions and outcomes


**Requirements**
* 2\-5 years of experience in Recruitment and Talent Acquisition
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end recruitment, preferably in non\-IT and volume hiring environments
* Proficiency in CRM/ATS tools and the Microsoft Office Suite
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment with strong stakeholder management skills


**Why Join Us?**
 We're scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you'll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and performance\-based incentives on of number of joiners.
* Opportunity for growth and career development.
* A dynamic and supportive work environment

**About Dulcet H**oldings: Dulcet Holdings India Private Limited is a premier financial services and investment operations firm. We are scaling our high\-performing Investment Banking and Capital Markets teams in india. We are looking for an agile **HR Recruiter cum Trainer** who can bridge the gap between acquiring top\-tier financial talent and preparing them for operational excellence in core banking and institutional market products.

**Role O**verview: This is a high\-visibility, dual\-impact role. You will own the full\-lifecycle recruitment for niche financial profiles and simultaneously design and deliver domain\-specific onboarding, technical workflows, and soft\-skills training programs.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **End\-to\-End Talent Acquisition:** Source, screen, and hire niche professionals across Investment Banking (Corporate Finance, M\&A, Equity Research) and
* **Global Trade Products** (Trade Finance, Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, Document Collections, Supply Chain Finance, and Cross\-Border Payments).
* **Pipeline Management:** Leverage LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, and financial networks to maintain a warm talent pipeline within the competitive Bengaluru hub.
* **Onboarding \& Technical Training Delivery:** Facilitate comprehensive induction modules covering basic financial concepts, capital markets infrastructure, corporate valuation toolkits, compliance, and structural workflows of transactional trade finance products.
* **Talent Development:** Conduct training needs analysis (TNA) and execute workshops for soft skills, business communication, and leadership alignment.
* **Metric Tracking:** Monitor key metrics like time\-to\-hire, post\-training assessment scores, and early\-stage candidate retention.

**Probation Period Policy**

* **Duration:** All new hires will undergo a mandatory **6\-month probation period** from their date of joining.
* **Evaluation:** Performance, adaptability, and culture\-fit will be reviewed at the end of the 1, 2, 3rd and 5th months.
* **Confirmation:** Upon successful completion of the 6\-month period and meeting all baseline KPIs, the employee will receive a formal Letter of Confirmation. The probation period may be extended up to a maximum of 3 additional months at the management's discretion if performance benchmarks are not fully met.
* **Mandatory Legal \& Compliance F**ramework. At Dulcet Holdings, we operate under a strict code of ethics and corporate governance.
* **Strict Legal Alignment:** Every internal company policy, code of conduct, and operational workflow strictly adheres to the local laws of Bengaluru, the Government of Karnataka, and the Government of India (including statutory regulations governed by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, SEBI, RBI guidelines on Trade/Forex, and Central Labour Laws).
* **Policy Rejection \& Precedence:** Any internal company policy, practice, or operational mandate that is found to cross, conflict with, or contradict government regulations, statutory compliance requirements, or employee rights under Indian law will be **automatically deemed null, void, and rejected**. Government laws and statutory regulations will permanently take absolute legal precedence over internal company guidelines under all circumstances.

**Candidate Eligibility Criteria**

* **Education:** Graduate or Post Graduate degree in Human Resources, Finance, or Business Administration (MBA/PGDM preferred).
* **Experience:** 3 to 6 years of proven experience combining recruitment and training functions inside an Investment Bank, KPO, Global Capability Center (GCC), or Corporate/Transaction Banking setup.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Strong foundational understanding of Investment Banking products, financial modelling basics, and
* **Trade Finance products** (PID, SID, vendor finance etc ).
* **Tools:** Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Learning Management Systems (LMS), and advanced Excel/PowerPoint.

**Compensation \& CTC S**tructure:

We offer a competitive package ranging from **₹6,00,000 to ₹9,50,000 per annum**, structured to reward high performance:

* **Fixed Base Salary (80%):** Standard assured monthly salary (inclusive of Basic, HRA, PF, and statutory allowances).
* **Recruitment Performance Bonus (15%):** Paid out quarterly based on mandate fulfillment, time\-to\-hire efficiency, and 90\-day candidate retention.
* **Training Incentive (5%):** Tied to successful batch onboarding timelines and post\-training assessment pass rates.

**Performance Framework \& PIP P**olicy: Performance is formally audited on a quarterly basis against clear benchmarks:

* **Hiring Funnel:** Maintaining a minimum 85% achievement rate on monthly sourcing and onboarding mandates.
* **Training Pass Rate:** Ensuring a minimum 80% average score on post\-onboarding technical evaluations (covering IB basics and Trade operations).
* **Retention Rate:** Maintaining early\-stage candidate attrition below 8% within the first 60 days.

**30\-Day PIP Policy:** If a confirmed team member fails to meet at least 70% of their combined recruitment and training KPIs for two consecutive quarters, or shows significant gaps in process compliance, they will be placed on a structured **30\-day Performance Improvement Plan (PIP)**. This period includes dedicated weekly mentorship and clear milestones. Successful completion restores normal standing, while failure to meet the PIP metrics will result in exit separation. *(Note: The PIP policy applies strictly to confirmed employees; performance shortfalls during the initial Probation Period are handled under standard probation review terms).*

**How to A**pply: If you are a blended HR professional who thrives in a fast\-paced investment and transactional banking ecosystem, we want to hear from you!

**Send your updated resume to:** hr@dulcetholding.com  
**Subject Line:** Application: HR Recruiter cum Trainer (IB \& Trade) \- Bengaluru

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement
* Work from home

title: Quantaco - Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Company Overview**
Quantaco, a leading Australian data\-driven technology company, is redefining how accounting services are delivered to the hospitality sector. By combining bespoke technology with deep industry expertise, we provide an all\-encompassing financial reporting platform that supports end\-to\-end account processing, reconciliation, management reporting, inventory management, and data analytics. **Role Outline**
The Talent Acquisition Specialist is a hands\-on role responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle for IT and non\-IT hiring across our growing Hyderabad\-based Global Capability Centre team. Supported by the Senior Talent Acquisition Manager, you will partner with the business to understand talent needs, build robust sourcing strategies, and drive quality hiring outcomes through data analysis and process rigor. You will collaborate closely with the Sydney and Hyderabad People \& Culture team and work in partnership with our Talent as a Service business, Talent Formula, to execute advanced talent strategies. This position is crucial for supporting Quantaco's strategic growth objectives, enhancing our employer brand within the Indian market, and ensuring we have the right people in the right roles at the right time for us to grow. **Key Responsibilities*** Drive fast\-paced, high\-volume, and business\-critical hiring while maintaining quality and a positive candidate experience.
* Own and manage high\-volume, niche, and senior hiring, driving the full recruitment lifecycle for a diverse range of roles, including accounting and finance, tech roles (IT), business support positions (non\-IT) and Senior Roles within our Hyderabad office.
* Partner with hiring managers to deeply understand their talent needs and formulate advanced recruitment strategies that ensure timely and high\-quality hiring outcomes.
* Design, develop, and implement effective sourcing strategies to identify and attract top\-tier talent, proactively building and maintaining robust talent pipelines for critical and frequently hired roles across all functions.
* Lead the sourcing, screening, and assessment of candidates partnering with Talent Formula’s resourcing team.
* Use a variety of channels, including executive search techniques, job boards, professional networks, social media, and internal databases, ensuring alignment with Quantaco's values and technical requirements.
* Ensure the effective administration and management of the candidate journey within Keka, our HRIS platform, upholding accurate data entry, timely communication, and process adherence for all candidates.
* Drive exceptional candidate engagement through a professional, communicative, and positive approach to candidate management throughout the entire recruitment lifecycle.
* Oversee the efficient coordination and scheduling of interviews with various stakeholders, including Recruiters, technical interviewers, and client interviewers.
* Collaborate with the Senior Talent Acquisition Manager in Sydney on talent acquisition strategy development, process improvements, and providing data\-driven reporting on recruitment metrics.
* Collaborate with the People \& Culture team to support the preparation of contracts and offer letters, conducting preboarding activities to reconfirm offer details with candidates.
* Drive employer branding to enhance employee engagement and retention.
* Continuously monitor recruitment best practices, market trends, and talent acquisition technologies, implementing innovative approaches.
* Manage and negotiate with external recruitment suppliers and agencies, ensuring a high\-quality candidate pipeline iis consistently available and effectively working with the approved panel of suppliers.

**Values\-aligned behaviours**
Our values drive our everyday behaviours and guide our decision\-making, therefore having alignment with them is critical:**Customer obsessed;** in this role, your customers are our candidates and hiring managers. Ensuring that streamlined and effective hiring processes are conducted will demonstrate your customer obsession.**Collaborative;** this role requires you to be self\-motivated but eager to collaborate with managers and colleagues ensure that the right people are hired into the right roles at the right time.**Curious;** having a natural desire to find a better way to conduct recruitment processes or open talent pipelines.**Creative;** we have a defined path to follow for our processes. However, we are open to seeking new, innovative, or creative ways to be successful or secure a better outcome. **Skills, Knowledge, and Experience*** 5\+ years Talent Acquisition experience with deep expertise across the full lifecycle
* Demonstrated experience owning and driving recruitment for diverse roles, including accounting and finance, tech roles, business support and senior hard to fill positions within the Indian market, ideally services Australian or global business.
* Proven track record in high\-volume, niche, and leadership\-level recruitment
* Strong understanding and proven application of recruitment best practices, advanced sourcing techniques, and candidate assessment methodologies
* Developing and executing comprehensive sourcing strategies to build strong talent pipelines.
* Sharp negotiation skills for effective offer management and confident counter\-offer handling.
* High ownership, a strong bias for action, and a collaborative style.
* Comfort managing ambiguity, competing priorities, and a high volume of open roles in a dynamic
* environment.
* Actively explores and implements AI, automation, and technology\-led approaches to make Talent Acquisition faster, smarter, and more scalable.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate Quantaco’s value proposition effectively, build strong rapport with senior candidates and stakeholders, and maintain professional communication across teams and locations.
* Business Acumen: You understand why we are hiring, not just what we are hiring for, and can translate business priorities into actionable talent strategies.
* Talent Ownership: You own the outcome from requirement to onboarding and beyond, rather than measuring success only by offer closure Stakeholder Management: You can confidently engage, influence and challenge senior stakeholders while building trust and credibility.
* Commercial Mindset: You understand the economics of hiring budget, compensation, internal parity, market positioning, cost and quality of hire.
* A Postgraduate Degree in Human Resources or similar from a reputable institution is highly preferred

description:
Technology Recruiter – India
 
  





**Location:** 
 India
 



**Company:** 
 Inspire Talent
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Recruitment Manager / Head of Talent
   




 About Inspire Talent
 
  





 Inspire Talent is a UK\-headquartered technology consultancy and talent solutions business supporting clients across the UK, US, Europe and other international markets.
 



 We help organisations attract, develop and retain high\-quality technology talent through specialist recruitment, consulting resources and our Academy / Hire\-Train\-Deploy programmes.
 



  





 Our technology recruitment spans areas including:
 



  




* Software Engineering
* Data Engineering \& Analytics
* Cloud \& DevOps
* AI \& Machine Learning
* SAP
* ServiceNow
* Snowflake
* Salesforce
* Financial Markets Technology
* Other specialist and niche technology roles



  





 We are looking for an ambitious
 **Technology Recruiter** 
 to join our growing recruitment team in India and support hiring across our international client base.
 



  




 The Role
 
  





 As a Technology Recruiter, you will be responsible for identifying, engaging and managing high\-quality candidates across a range of technology disciplines.
 



 This is an end\-to\-end recruitment role. You will work closely with our recruitment, sales and delivery teams to understand client requirements, develop sourcing strategies and build strong pipelines of candidates.
 



 You will recruit across both experienced technology professionals and, where required, graduate and early\-career talent for Inspire Talent's Academy programmes.
 



 The successful candidate will be proactive, commercially aware and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where candidate quality and speed of delivery are equally important.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 
  




 Candidate Sourcing \& Recruitment
 
  




* Manage the recruitment lifecycle from initial sourcing through to interview, offer and onboarding.
* Proactively source candidates using LinkedIn, job boards, internal databases, referrals and other recruitment channels.
* Conduct structured screening calls to assess technical experience, communication skills, motivations, salary expectations and availability.
* Build talent pipelines for current and anticipated client requirements.
* Develop expertise within key technology markets and understand where relevant talent can be found.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.


 Technology Recruitment
 
  





 Recruit across a range of technical disciplines, potentially including:
 



  




* Java, Python, C\# and software engineering
* Data Engineering, SQL, Spark, Databricks and Kafka
* AWS, Azure and GCP
* DevOps, Kubernetes, Docker and Terraform
* AI / Machine Learning
* Snowflake
* SAP
* ServiceNow
* Salesforce
* Financial Markets and banking technology



 You do not need to be an expert across every technology, but you should be comfortable learning technical terminology and understanding the difference between candidate profiles.
   




 Client \& Delivery Support
 
  




* Work closely with Account Managers and the wider recruitment team to understand client requirements.
* Translate job specifications into effective candidate search strategies.
* Present strong candidate shortlists with clear, concise candidate summaries.
* Coordinate interviews and manage candidate feedback.
* Support offer negotiations and candidate closing.
* Identify potential recruitment challenges early and communicate these to the wider team.
* Deliver against agreed recruitment targets and client deadlines.



  




 Academy \& Graduate Recruitment
 
  





 Inspire Talent operates technology Academy programmes where graduates and early\-career professionals are recruited, assessed and trained before deployment to clients.
 



 The recruiter may support:
 


* Graduate and early\-career candidate sourcing.
* High\-volume recruitment campaigns.
* Initial competency and motivation screening.
* Coordination of technical assessments.
* Candidate assessment days and interview processes.
* Building talent pools ahead of future Academy programmes.
* Ensuring candidates understand the training, deployment and longer\-term career opportunity.


 What We Are Looking ForEssential
 * 2–5 years' experience within recruitment or talent acquisition.
* Experience recruiting technology or IT professionals.
* Strong candidate sourcing skills, particularly through LinkedIn and job boards.
* Experience conducting candidate screening and qualification calls.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and candidate processes simultaneously.
* Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with international colleagues and clients.
* Target\-driven with a strong sense of ownership and urgency.


 Desirable
 
 Experience recruiting within one or more of the following areas would be particularly valuable:
 


* Banking or Financial Services technology
* Software Engineering
* Data Engineering
* Cloud / DevOps
* SAP
* ServiceNow
* Snowflake
* Salesforce
* Graduate technology recruitment
* International recruitment, particularly UK, US or European markets


 What Good Looks Like
 
 We are looking for someone who goes beyond simply searching CV databases.
 



 A successful recruiter at Inspire Talent will:
 


* Understand the requirement before starting a search.
* Proactively headhunt rather than relying solely on applicants.
* Speak confidently with technology professionals.
* Qualify candidates properly before presenting them.
* Build relationships and maintain candidate pipelines.
* Communicate clearly when a search is proving difficult.
* Work collaboratively with sales, account management and delivery teams.
* Take ownership of vacancies from initial briefing through to successful placement.
* Represent Inspire Talent professionally in every candidate interaction.


 Key Performance Indicators
 
 Performance will typically be measured across:
 


* Qualified candidates submitted.
* Candidate\-to\-interview conversion.
* Interview\-to\-offer conversion.
* Successful placements.
* Time to shortlist / time to hire.
* Candidate pipeline development.
* Quality and accuracy of candidate information.
* Candidate engagement and offer acceptance.
* Delivery against individual and team recruitment targets.


 Why Join Inspire Talent?
 
 This is an opportunity to join a growing international technology talent business rather than a traditional volume recruitment environment.
 



 You will have exposure to specialist technology markets, international clients and different talent solutions ranging from experienced recruitment through to large\-scale Academy and workforce programmes.
 



 Inspire Talent's model combines recruitment with technical assessment, training, certification and ongoing candidate development, giving our recruitment team the opportunity to build longer\-term careers as well as make individual placements.
   




 The Opportunity
 
  





 We are looking for someone who wants to develop with the business.
 



  




* For the right person, there will be opportunities to take greater responsibility for particular technology markets, client accounts and recruitment programmes as Inspire Talent continues to grow internationally.

**About Us** 




 We are building the future of hiring through AI\-driven recruitment and technical assessments.
 



 At CodeRound, we help startups and fast\-growing companies hire top engineering, AI, and product talent faster and more effectively.
 



  





 We work with high\-growth startups, founders, and talent teams to streamline hiring through technology, strong recruiting operations, and exceptional candidate experience.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Talent Acquisition professional who can manage client relationships end\-to\-end while driving hiring outcomes across multiple roles.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys both:
 


* working closely with clients and founders,
* and executing strong recruitment processes to close top talent.



 You will act as the bridge between clients, candidates, and internal recruiting operations.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Client Management** 



* Manage relationships with startup founders, hiring managers, and talent teams
* Understand hiring requirements, team structures, and role expectations
* Conduct intake calls and align on hiring strategy
* Share regular hiring updates, pipelines, and candidate feedback
* Build long\-term client relationships and ensure high satisfaction



  





**Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition** 



* Source and screen candidates across engineering, AI, product, and startup roles
* Coordinate interviews and manage hiring pipelines
* Evaluate candidate fit across technical skills, communication, and culture
* Maintain strong turnaround times and candidate experience
* Work with recruiters and sourcing teams to improve delivery quality



  




* **Operations \& Coordination**
* Manage multiple open roles simultaneously
* Track hiring metrics and pipeline progress
* Ensure smooth coordination between clients and candidates
* Improve recruitment workflows and hiring processes
* Use AI tools and recruitment platforms effectively



  





**Requirements** 



* 0\-2 years of experience in recruitment, staffing, talent acquisition, or account management
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience handling clients directly is preferred
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment
* Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously
* Experience hiring for tech or startup roles is a plus



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Someone proactive and highly dependable
* Strong relationship\-building ability
* Excellent follow\-through and responsiveness
* Commercial understanding of hiring and business needs
* Someone who genuinely enjoys helping companies hire great talent



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work directly with startup founders and leadership teams
* High ownership and rapid career growth
* Exposure to AI\-driven hiring and modern recruitment workflows
* Opportunity to shape hiring processes at an early\-stage startup
* Fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environment

description:
Are you ready to accelerate your career?

 **Cielo Recruiter** 
 , you will play a critical role in identifying and attracting top talent across the automotive, steel, manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, and industrial sectors. Acting as a trusted talent advisor to hiring leaders, you will deliver exceptional candidate experiences while driving proactive sourcing strategies and providing valuable market insights.

 Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

 English

* Steel, Metals \& Materials

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
   

  

 As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
   

  

 What You Can Expect
   

  

 As a Zimmer Biomet full life\-cycle Talent Partner, you will join the global Talent Acquisition team and lead efforts attracting, sourcing, and selecting top\-tier talent to join our team. You will work closely with hiring managers and HR partners in a consultative role to understand staffing needs, develop effective recruitment strategies, and ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience and meeting agreed KPIs.
   

  

 This role will be a part of the Talent Acqusition Commercial team and support hiring in Australia and New Zealand and India but also other global locations as required.
   

  

 How You'll Create Impact
   

  

* Collaborate with hiring managers to define job requirements and qualifications.
* Utilize data and up\-to\-date market insights to advice on market realities or alternatives.
* Develop and implement effective sourcing strategies within a variety of channels.
* Conduct thorough screening and assessment of candidates to ensure alignment with Zimmer Biomet’s requirements, culture, and values.
* Guide the manager and candidate through the interview phases, ensuring a robust and effective assessment and engaging experience for the candidate.
* Artfully manage offers and negotiations, finding a successful outcome for both parties.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates, growing the future pipeline.
* Stay informed of industry trends, competitive landscape, and best practices to continually improve the recruitment process and experience.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of talent acquisition initiatives and projects.


 What Makes You Stand Out
   

  

* Strong sourcing techniques
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to quickly establish rapport and credibility with hiring managers and candidates.
* Influencing and negotiation skills
* Fluency in English and local language


 Your Background
   

  

* 3\+ years of experience as a full life cycle Talent Advisor/Partner
* Experience has a consultative advisor, driving the recruitment process and outcomes.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and other HR software.


 EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

title: Talent Acquisition Head
description:
**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




  





 Monarch Networth Capital has grown from ₹2 Crore PAT to ₹181 Crore PAT in six years. Our networth has crossed ₹1,000 Crore. We have built 8 fast growing business verticals from the ground up. And we have achieved this with one belief, the right people, in the right roles, with the right ownership, can build anything.
 



 But here is the truth: our growth has outpaced our ability to hire at the speed and quality we need. We are hiring across every vertical: Retail Broking, Investment Banking, Institutional Equities, AIF, PMS, Wealth Management, Compliance, Technology, and our upcoming AMC. Each role demands a specific kind of person \- not just qualified, but entrepreneurial. Not just experienced, but hungry.
 



 We don't need an HR recruiter. We need a Talent Acquisition Head who thinks like a CEO, someone who understands that every hire either accelerates or slows down the company, and treats recruitment with that level of seriousness.
 



  





**THE MONARCH CONTEXT — WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT** 




  





 This is not a 10,000\-employee company where hiring is a volume game. This is a high growth, high conviction platform where every hire is visible, every person matters.
 



  





 A few things you should know before you apply:
 



 ▸
 **Lowest attrition rate in the industry.** 
 People don't leave Monarch. Your job is to ensure the people who join are the reason others stay, not the reason they leave.
 



  





 ▸
 **8 verticals, each with distinct hiring needs.** 
 A Research Analyst is a fundamentally different hire from a Deal Originator or a Compliance Head. You need to understand every business deeply enough to know what "great" looks like in each role.
 



  





 ▸
 **We have never hired through advertising.** 
 Every senior hire has come through networks, referrals, and direct outreach. You need to build and own those pipelines.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**1\. Talent Strategy \& Planning** 




 ▸ Own the entire talent acquisition function end\-to\-end, from workforce planning and JD creation to sourcing, screening, offer negotiation, and onboarding handoff.
 



  





 ▸ Work directly with the CEO and business heads to understand hiring priorities, role requirements, and the specific DNA of candidates who succeed at Monarch, not just on paper, but in our culture.
 



  





**2\. Sourcing \& Outreach** 




 ▸ Develop a direct sourcing engine \- headhunting, industry mapping, passive candidate outreach, alumni networks, conference networking.
 



  





**3\. Screening \& Quality Control** 




 ▸ Implement a rigorous screening process that filters for three things: competence, culture fit, and ownership mindset. Technical skills get you in the door. Attitude determines if you stay.
 



  





**4\. Individual Contribution** 




 ▸ While you lead a small team, you also personally drive the CXO and senior level hiring for the organization to find the right fit leaders for our next phase of growth.
 



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




  





**Experience :** 
 8\-15 years in talent acquisition, with at least 3 years heading the function.
 **Financial services experience strongly preferred.** 




  





**Industry Understanding :** 
 Must understand the financial services talent landscape \- broking, investment banking, research, compliance, fund management.
 



  





**Sourcing Expertise :** 
 Proven track record of direct sourcing and headhunting for senior/niche roles.
 



  





**Tools :** 
 Proficient in LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, recruitment analytics. Advanced Excel for MIS.
 



  





**Education :** 
 MBA in HR / Postgraduate in Human Resources preferred.
 



  





**Location :** 
 Mumbai

**Please note:** 
 We value honesty, integrity, accountability, confidentiality, strong work ethic, and a genuine willingness to learn and contribute. This is a hands\-on internship, and we are looking for someone who is serious about gaining practical HR experience and is prepared to take ownership of their responsibilities.

 **Talent Acquisition** 
 .

 **strong integrity, honesty, discretion, and professional ethics** 
 . The ideal candidate should be
 **dependable, trustworthy, proactive, and genuinely interested in building a career in Human Resources** 
 . We value individuals who take ownership of their responsibilities, are willing to learn, and approach their work with commitment and seriousness.
 



 This is a
 **hands\-on role** 
 and would be best suited for someone who is eager to contribute, take responsibility, and make the most of the opportunity rather than simply looking for an internship experience on paper.

* Support attendance, leave, and other employee\-related HR activities.
* Ensure HR records and databases are updated accurately and on time.
* Assist with preparing HR reports, MIS, and other routine documentation.



  





**3\. Employee Engagement \& HR Initiatives (\~10%)** 



* Assist in planning and coordinating employee engagement activities and events.
* Support internal HR communications and employee initiatives.
* Help conduct employee surveys, feedback initiatives, and HR programs.
* Assist in organizing team activities, celebrations, and employee engagement programs.

* Support periodic employee review and feedback activities.
* Assist with employee lifecycle processes such as transfers, role changes, confirmations, and exits.

* Assist with developing and maintaining HR policies, templates, forms, and process documentation.
* Conduct basic HR research and benchmarking when required.
* Support audits, compliance\-related documentation, and HR data preparation.
* Take ownership of assigned HR tasks and projects and ensure timely completion.
* Provide general HR support across functions based on business requirements.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Strong interest in Talent Acquisition and Human Resources.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.

* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets, MS Office/Google Workspace, and willingness to learn HR tools and systems.

**What You’ll Gain**

* Experience working directly with hiring managers and business teams.

title: Intern - Founder’s Office
description:
Most internships give you a defined role, a manager, and work that has already been figured out by someone else. This is not that.
 



  





 You are joining an early\-stage project of a fintech startup at the point where almost nothing exists yet. No playbook, no process, no team to fall back on. Things will be unclear. Priorities will change mid\-week. You will be handed problems nobody has solved before, and you will be expected to come back with an answer rather than a question. If that sounds exhausting, this is not for you.
 



  





 If it sounds like the most interesting six months you could spend, keep reading.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





**What the job actually is** 




  





 You work on whatever the founder is working on.
 



  





**Research** 
  — market sizing, competitor teardowns, regulatory reading, background on a company or a person before a meeting. You form a view; you don't just collect links.
 



  





**Partnership outreach** 
  — building target lists, writing the first email, preparing materials, and following up until there is an answer. Not one follow\-up. Until there is an answer.
 



  





**Hiring** 
  — writing JDs, sourcing, screening, taking first\-round interviews, running the process end to end. You will be interviewing people older than you. You will be expected to be good at it.
 



  





**Product** 
  — reviewing flows, writing copy, testing releases, finding what is broken before a customer does.
 



  





**Meetings** 
  — brief before, notes during, actions after, and chasing every action until it is closed.
 



  





**Decks and documents** 
  — investor and partner material, one\-pagers, process notes. Written well enough that they go out without being rewritten.
 



  





**Coordination** 
  — across design, tech, operations, vendors. Much of the job is simply making sure nothing gets dropped, because at this stage things get dropped constantly.
 



  





**Everything else** 
  — genuinely half the role. If something needs doing and nobody owns it, it is yours now.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





**What we are actually looking for** 




  





 Not a CV. These:
 



  





**You move fast.** 
  A day is a long time at this stage. Things that can be done today do not get done tomorrow.
 



  





**You finish things.** 
  Starting is easy and common. The rare quality is closing something out completely, without being reminded.
 



  





**You own outcomes, not tasks.** 
  "I sent the email" is not the answer. "It's done, here's what they said" is.
 



  





**You are resourceful before you are stuck.** 
  Figure it out, try something, use every tool available. Then ask — quickly, and with a specific question.
 



  





**You take feedback straight.** 
  It will be direct and frequent, because there is no time for the softened version. It is about the work, never about you.
 



  





**You have high standards when nobody is checking.** 
  Most of what you produce will not be reviewed line by line. It still has to be right.
 



  





**You want to build a company, not observe one.** 
  People who want a brand name for their CV will find this uncomfortable. People who want to know how it is actually done will not want to leave.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





**Basics** 




  




* Recent graduate or final\-year student. Any field.
* Writes clearly — most of what you produce leaves the building as writing.
* Comfortable talking to people you've never met: candidates, vendors, partners.
* Organised enough that things do not slip.
* Based in Mumbai, in office. This role does not work remotely.
* No finance or fintech background required. The domain is learnable. Drive is not.



  





 ⸻
 



  





**What you get** 




  




* You work directly with the founder. No layers, no filtering, nothing passed down third\-hand.
* You see the whole company being built — hiring, product, partnerships, fundraising — at the stage where every decision is still visible.
* Responsibility far beyond what your CV currently justifies.
* Stipend: ₹10,000 per month.
* A full\-time offer for the right person, and a genuine shot at growing with the company as it scales.



  





 ⸻
 



  





**The honest part** 




  





 Some of this work is exciting. Some of it is tedious. Both have to be done properly, and at this stage the same person does both.
 



  





 You will make mistakes and they will be visible, because there is nobody in between you and the outcome. That is also exactly why you will learn faster here than anywhere else.
 



  





 ⸻

 **HR Generalist who can independently own HR end\-to\-end**

 You will work directly with the founders and department heads and will be responsible for making HR work efficiently as the company grows.
 



**There is no HR lead above you for day\-to\-day guidance.**

 **People/HR Manager**

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Procurement functions in \>80% companies are run on email/excel/phone calls \- leading to inefficiencies, delays in procurement and cost leakages up to 20%. Procol is a platform to help procurement go from legacy, manual, excel / email based processes to automated systems \- becoming \~50% efficient, 2x faster, and delivering 2\-10% overall cost savings.
 



  





 Founded in 2018, Procol's solutions have been securely deployed at many $1B\+ global companies helping procurement teams reduce costs, digitize procurements, and improve compliance by replacing emails and Excel workflows with the world's most easy\-to\-use and secure procurement platform managing a spend of $5Bn\+. Procol is rated 4\.9/5 by trusted enterprises on G2 and has been featured by Forbes.
 



  





 We're a team of ex\-Google New York, Zomato, OYO who've worked at high\-impact, growth companies and believe that we're on the journey of building one. We are backed by investors like Blume Ventures, Peak XV Surge, Beenext, and Rainmatter.
 



  





 Hiring for
 **Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist** 




  





 At Procol, Talent Acquisition is more than just filling open positions—it’s about understanding the business, identifying exceptional talent, and building teams that can shape the future of the company. Our talent team works closely with hiring managers and leadership to understand what great looks like, build strong talent pipelines, and create a thoughtful candidate experience from first conversation to offer.
 



  





 We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment, has a strong understanding of end\-to\-end recruitment, and is passionate about finding high\-quality talent for challenging roles. If you’re someone who can spot exceptional talent, build meaningful relationships, and balance speed with quality, this is the place for you.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* **Own End\-to\-End Hiring:** 
 Take complete ownership of the recruitment lifecycle—from understanding requirements and sourcing candidates to interviewing, closing, and onboarding—across multiple functions and levels.
* **Partner with Hiring Managers:** 
 Work closely with founders, business leaders, and hiring managers to understand hiring needs, define ideal candidate profiles, calibrate on talent, and build effective hiring strategies.
* **Build Strong Talent Pipelines:** 
 Proactively identify and engage high\-quality candidates through LinkedIn, referrals, communities, networks, and other creative sourcing channels, building pipelines even before roles open.
* **Drive Quality Hiring:** 
 Go beyond matching resumes to job descriptions by evaluating candidates for skills, potential, cultural alignment, and long\-term fit with the organization.
* **Own Candidate Experience:** 
 Act as a trusted point of contact for candidates throughout the process, ensuring clear communication, timely feedback, and a thoughtful experience at every stage.
* **Close Exceptional Talent:** 
 Build strong relationships with candidates, understand their motivations and aspirations, effectively communicate the opportunity, and drive successful offer closures.
* **Innovate and Improve:** 
 Continuously experiment with new sourcing strategies, tools, channels, and processes to improve hiring efficiency, quality, and speed.
* **Build Employer Brand:** 
 Help strengthen Procol’s talent brand by creating compelling candidate touchpoints, leveraging employee networks, and identifying opportunities to attract top talent.
* **Use Data to Drive Hiring:** 
 Track and analyze recruitment metrics such as pipeline health, source effectiveness, conversion rates, time\-to\-hire, and offer acceptance to continuously improve the hiring process.
* **Contribute Strategically:** 
 Bring market intelligence and talent insights to the business, helping leaders understand talent availability, compensation trends, competitive hiring practices, and evolving candidate expectations.



  





**What would you bring to the table** 



* **3–6 years of experience** 
 in Talent Acquisition or recruitment, preferably within a fast\-paced startup, technology, or B2B SaaS environment.
* Strong experience managing
 **end\-to\-end recruitment** 
 across multiple functions, with a proven track record of hiring high\-quality talent.
* Excellent
 **sourcing and headhunting skills** 
 , with the ability to identify and engage passive candidates through creative and structured approaches.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to
 **partner effectively with senior leaders and hiring managers** 
 and influence hiring decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to
 **evaluate talent beyond the resume** 
 , with strong interviewing, assessment, and candidate evaluation skills.
* A strong
 **candidate\-first mindset** 
 , with excellent communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Proven ability to
 **close candidates** 
 and navigate compensation discussions, counteroffers, competing offers, and other challenges in the hiring process.
* Strong understanding of
 **talent markets, compensation benchmarks, and hiring trends** 
 , with the ability to translate these insights into actionable hiring strategies.
* A data\-driven approach to recruitment, with the ability to use hiring metrics to identify bottlenecks and improve processes.
* A high degree of
 **ownership, hustle, and adaptability** 
 , with the ability to operate independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* A passion for building teams and a genuine curiosity about
 **people, products, and businesses** 
 .

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist - CBS026
description:
We are looking for a hands\-on TA professional who wants to be part of our growth journey—someone who doesn't just work on assigned vacancies but proactively identifies talent, builds pipelines, solves hiring challenges, and takes ownership of recruitment outcomes.
   

  

 Job Location: Ambli Bopal, Ahmedabad
   

  

 Shift : 10:00 AM to 7:30 PM
   

  

 Work Experience: 4–7 Years
   

  

 Travel: Willingness to travel to other states as required
   

  

 Key Competencies
   

  

 Talent Acquisition \| Sourcing \| Stakeholder Management \| Candidate Screening \| Interview Coordination \| Offer Management \| Employer Branding \| Talent Pipeline Management \| Recruitment Analytics \| Negotiation \| Communication \| Ownership \& Initiative
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process from sourcing to onboarding.
* Understand business requirements and develop effective recruitment strategies for different roles.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, networking, databases, and other relevant channels.
* Conduct initial screening, telephonic/video interviews, and assess candidates based on skills, experience, communication, and organizational fit.
* Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and business stakeholders.
* Manage multiple open positions simultaneously while ensuring timely closure of requirements.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs.
* Proactively identify and implement new sourcing strategies to improve the quality and speed of hiring.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand workforce requirements, role expectations, and hiring priorities.
* Take ownership of recruitment targets and provide regular updates on hiring progress.
* Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment lifecycle and ensure a positive candidate experience.
* Negotiate offers and coordinate with selected candidates until joining.
* Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment data in the ATS/recruitment system.
* Support recruitment drives, walk\-in interviews, campus hiring, job fairs, and other talent acquisition initiatives.
* Be willing to travel to other states/locations for recruitment drives, hiring requirements, and expansion\-related TA activities.
* Assist in developing and strengthening the company's employer brand and recruitment presence.
* Monitor recruitment trends and explore new channels, tools, and approaches to attract quality talent.
* Support the TA team in achieving overall hiring objectives and continuously improve recruitment processes.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

* Experience: 4–7 years of relevant experience in Talent Acquisition/Recruitment.
* Strong experience in end\-to\-end recruitment and volume/multiple\-position hiring.
* Excellent sourcing and candidate screening skills.
* Strong stakeholder and hiring\-manager management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong negotiation and candidate management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proactive, self\-driven, and ownership\-oriented approach.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and take quick decisions when required.
* Willingness and flexibility to travel to other states for recruitment activities.
* Experience in hiring for Accounting, Finance, KPO/BPO, IT, or other professional services will be an added advantage.

description:
**Overview:**

The Talent Acquisition Manager will play a key role in enabling business growth by attracting and bringing in the right talent to support current and future business needs. Reporting to the Head of TAA, the role will be expected to work closely with business and HR stakeholders to understand evolving talent requirements and translate these into effective sourcing and hiring strategies.


The Talent Acquisition Manager will provide market insights, sourcing expertise and strategic hiring support to deliver high\-quality hiring outcomes across multiple functions and geographies. The role will also be expected to enhance the candidate experience, support diversity hiring ambitions and contribute to employer branding initiatives that strengthen Maersk’s ability to attract and engage the right talent.


**What You Can Expect:**

* Deliver timely and high\-quality hiring outcomes through effective sourcing and talent attraction strategies.
* Partner closely with business leaders and HR stakeholders to understand hiring requirements, workforce capabilities, and talent gaps.
* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment activities, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for both candidates and hiring managers.
* Build and nurture talent pipelines through relevant hiring communities, professional networks, industry forums, and events.
* Leverage market insights and talent intelligence to advise stakeholders on talent availability, competitor landscapes, and hiring trends.
* Support and advocate diversity hiring initiatives to help achieve Maersk's diversity and inclusion ambitions.
* Contribute to employer branding and talent attraction initiatives that enhance Maersk's visibility and reputation as an employer of choice.
* Utilize innovative sourcing approaches and candidate engagement strategies to identify and attract top talent.
* Support continuous improvement of recruitment processes and hiring practices to drive efficiency and effectiveness.

**Critical Competencies:**

* 10\-12\+ years of recruitment and talent acquisition experience.
* Proven expertise in sourcing, talent attraction, and candidate engagement strategies.
* Experience driving employer branding and digital talent attraction campaigns.
* Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills.
* Talent market intelligence and workforce planning awareness.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Results orientation, attention to detail, and strong problem\-solving skills

**Internal Stakeholders**

* Business Leaders

* Employees and Hiring Managers

**External Stakeholders**

title: Deputy Manager - Talent Acquisition
description:
**Company Description** 
 Subros Limited, established in 1985 as a joint venture with Indian promoters, Denso Corporation Japan, and Suzuki Motor Corporation Japan, is a leading manufacturer of thermal products for automotive applications in India. The company has grown from a small assembly operation into the country’s largest and only integrated manufacturing unit for automotive air conditioning systems. Subros produces compressors, condensers, heat exchangers, and complete AC loop components for passenger vehicles, buses, trucks, refrigeration transport, off\-road equipment, residential air conditioners, and railways. With manufacturing plants in Noida, Manesar, Pune, Chennai, Nalagarh, and Karsanpura, Subros has an annual capacity of 2\.0 million AC kits. The organization also maintains a well\-equipped R\&D center and Tool Room in Noida, supporting continual innovation and product development.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Deputy Manager – Talent Acquisition is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Noida, responsible for managing end\-to\-end hiring activities across multiple functions and locations. This role involves overseeing the full recruitment lifecycle, including workforce planning, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and selecting candidates in alignment with business needs and organizational policies. The Deputy Manager will collaborate closely with hiring managers to define role requirements, develop job descriptions, and ensure a structured and fair selection process. Daily responsibilities include managing multiple recruitment channels, driving employer branding initiatives, maintaining recruitment dashboards, and ensuring a positive candidate experience. The role also includes partnering with HR leadership on recruitment strategies, campus and lateral hiring, adherence to compliance and diversity guidelines, and continuous improvement of talent acquisition processes.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong expertise in full\-life cycle recruiting and recruiting, including requisition management, sourcing, screening, selection, and offer negotiation.
* Demonstrated experience in hiring activities, such as manpower planning, coordination with hiring managers, and managing multiple open positions.
* Proficiency in interviewing, using structured techniques and assessment tools to evaluate skills, experience, and organizational fit.
* Experience in employer branding initiatives, including promoting the organization across digital platforms, campuses, and industry events.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Knowledge of HR best practices, recruitment analytics, and applicant tracking systems (ATS) or similar tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment, prioritize multiple requirements, and meet hiring timelines.
* Understanding of diversity, equity, and inclusion principles and commitment to fair and unbiased hiring practices.
* Prior experience in automotive

description:
About Straive 

Straive is a trusted leader in building and operationalizing enterprise data and AI solutions for top global brands and corporations. Our key differentiators include extensive domain expertise across multiple industry verticals, coupled with cutting-edge data analytics and AI capabilities that have consistently driven measurable ROI for our clients. With a global footprint spanning 30+ countries, Straive serves hundreds of clients, supported by a team of 18,000+ seasoned professionals in data, analytics, AI, and operations. Our offices are strategically located across India, the Philippines, the USA, Nicaragua, Vietnam, the UK, Canada, and Singapore, where our headquarters are based. 
 Position Overview 
 We are looking for a driven, people-oriented Talent Acquisition Intern to join our HR team in Chennai .This is an exceptional entry-level opportunity for a fresh graduate or someone with prior HR/recruitment internship experience to gain hands-on corporate recruiting exposure. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 As an intern , you will be deeply involved in supporting our daily recruitment operations. Your core focus areas will include: 
 Sourcing & Talent Mapping:Utilize job portals (Naukri, Indeed), LinkedIn, and social networks to identify and build pipelines of qualified candidates for active job roles. Resume Screening: Review inbound applications against specified job descriptions to shortlist high-quality matching profiles. Initial Screening: Conduct introductory phone interviews to assess candidates' fundamental communication skills, availability, and alignment with basic role requirements. Interview Coordination: Act as the primary bridge between candidates and our internal interviewing panels, managing schedules, sending calendar invites, and tracking feedback. Database & ATS Management: Ensure accurate, real-time updates of candidate pipelines and details within our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Candidate Experience: Serve as a welcoming, professional point of contact for candidates throughout their application journey, ensuring they receive timely updates. 
 Educational Background Bachelors or Masters degree in Human Resources, Business Administration (BBA/MBA), Psychology, or a related field.

 Familiarity with the concepts of basic sourcing, Boolean search logic, or utilizing online job boards (gained via coursework or previous internships). Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Excel for data tracking and Word for formatting resumes/JDs) or Google Workspace. Basic understanding of how corporate recruiting structures function. 
 Soft Skills & Competencies 
 Strong Communication: Excellent spoken and written English skills are mandatory to engage candidates effectively. Fluency in regional languages (like Tamil) is an advantage for vendor and local candidate coordination. Organizational Agility: Ability to juggle multiple scheduling tasks without losing track of details. Willingness to Learn: A proactive mindset, comfortable asking questions and adapting swiftly to feedback in a fast-paced environment.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





**Overview** 




 We are seeking a Talent Acquisition Specialist to own full\-cycle recruitment for Ecolibrium across technology, engineering, operations and business roles, with working knowledge of core HR processes to provide backup cover on HR administration when needed. The role will run sourcing, screening, interview coordination and offer management end\-to\-end, with role approvals and hiring decisions resting with the Head of HR/People and department heads.
 



  





 The Talent Acquisition Specialist will be the primary point of contact for every candidate and hiring manager — building genuine relationships with department heads to understand what they actually need, while applying the same fair, consistent process and standards to everyone in the pipeline.
 



  





 The Talent Acquisition Specialist will work directly with department heads to run their hiring pipelines with a high degree of autonomy, bringing the Head of HR/People in only for role approval, offer sign\-off, and communication with Finance on headcount. This is an ownership role requiring strong sourcing judgement, stakeholder management and the ability to run multiple requisitions independently with minimal oversight.
 



  





**THE WORK** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end recruitment for assigned requisitions, including sourcing strategy, screening, interview coordination and offer management, with minimal day\-to\-day oversight.
* Build and run sourcing strategies across job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, campus channels and other channels, adapting approach by role and market.
* Screen resumes and run initial screening conversations, exercising independent judgement on fit against role requirements.
* Coordinate interview scheduling with hiring managers and panel members, ensuring timely feedback and closure, and stepping in to unblock stalled pipelines.
* Own and maintain the applicant tracking system (ATS)/recruitment database, using it properly — accurate candidate and requisition status, clean reporting, no manual workarounds.
* Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment process, acting as a warm and reliable point of contact while applying the same standards and timelines fairly to every candidate.
* Run offer roll\-out independently, including reference checks, negotiation within approved bands, offer letter coordination and pre\-boarding documentation, escalating only exceptions.
* Coordinate with the HR/Admin Coordinator for smooth handover of new joiners to onboarding.
* Provide backup cover for core HR \& Admin Coordinator duties (onboarding support, basic employee queries, records) as required, ensuring continuity for employees.
* Post and manage job advertisements across job boards, the careers page and social media platforms.
* Track recruitment metrics such as time\-to\-fill, source of hire, pipeline status and offer acceptance rates, and report proactively rather than on request.
* Run campus and walk\-in recruitment drives, job fairs and other hiring events as required.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, MIS and weekly/monthly hiring reports.
* Manage vendor and recruitment agency relationships for select requisitions, including negotiating terms within agreed parameters.



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Essential** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field discipline.
* 3–5 years of relevant recruitment/talent acquisition experience, preferably in a technology, engineering or similar environment, including experience owning requisitions independently.
* Strong working knowledge of sourcing tools and channels, including LinkedIn, job portals and employee referral programmes, and the judgement to choose the right channel for the role.
* Solid experience using an applicant tracking system (ATS) or recruitment database to a high standard, not just as a data\-entry tool.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work directly and confidently with department heads.
* A genuinely warm, upbeat, people\-first personality — someone who comes across as happy and approachable with candidates and colleagues alike — paired with the discipline to apply the same process and standards consistently and fairly to everyone.
* Excellent organisational skills with the ability to run multiple requisitions independently and with minimal supervision.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, for recruitment tracking and reporting.
* Basic working knowledge of core HR processes (onboarding, records, employee lifecycle administration), sufficient to provide competent backup cover when required.
* High level of ownership, autonomy and attention to detail — comfortable making judgement calls without needing sign\-off on every step.



  





**Desirable** 



* Experience in technical/engineering hiring or campus recruitment.
* Exposure to employer branding or social media recruitment activities.
* Certification in recruitment or talent acquisition.

Withum empowers clients and our professional staff with innovative tools and solutions to address their accounting, tax and overall business management and operational needs. As a US nationally ranked Top 25 firm, we recruit only the best and brightest people with a genuine passion for the business.
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced Senior Recruiter to join our dynamic HR team in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in full\-cycle recruitment, with the ability to source, attract, and hire top talent for various roles within our firm. As a Senior Recruiter, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Withum by identifying and onboarding the best talent in the industry.
 



  





 Withum has become synonymous with teamwork and client service excellence. The cornerstone of our success can truly be accredited to the dedicated professionals who work here every day, easy to work with a sense of purpose and caring for their co\-workers and whose mission is to help our clients grow and thrive. But our commitment goes beyond our clients as we continue to live the Withum Way, promoting personal and professional growth for all team members, clients, and surrounding communities.
 



  





**How You'll Spend Your Time:** 



* Full\-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and selecting candidates for various roles across the firm.
* Talent Sourcing: Utilize various sourcing methods, including job boards, social media, networking events, and employee referrals, to identify and engage top talent.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with hiring managers and department heads to understand staffing needs and develop effective recruitment strategies.
* Candidate Experience: Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process by maintaining clear communication and providing timely feedback.
* Employer Branding: Contribute to enhancing Withum’s employer brand by promoting our culture, values, and opportunities through various channels.
