title: Technical Recruiter - FTC 12Months
description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 As a Recruiter at Wise you’ll be responsible for hiring the best talent for Product Engineering in Hyderabad. You’ll own talent management, helping ProdEng to scale to enable Wise to achieve our mission \- money without borders. You’ll be a key member of the recruitment team with a focus on delivering exceptional talent while keeping candidate and hiring manager experience front and centre of what you do.
   

  

 Culture is everything to us at Wise and identifying, finding and selecting the best talent to support our highly collaborative and non\-hierarchical culture is key. As a Recruiter you are vital to the overall success of Wise. The right person will have an excellent knowledge of talent management and understand how to partner effectively.
   

  

**Your Mission**
* You’ll help us scale our ProdEng teams over the next few years so we can help more customers save money using Wise
* You’ll manage candidates end\-to\-end ensuring they receive the best possible experience in line with Wise values, even if they weren’t successful (you never know, the perfect role might come up later), and build a strong talent network locally and internationally
* You’ll build and develop relationships with with hiring teams, guiding them through processes
* Always seeking growth opportunities, not afraid to step outside of your comfort zone and take a risk
* Collaborate with sourcers to understand the candidate market and engage the best talent
* Use data to support your hiring recommendations, as well as using it to retro processes, figure out the blockers to hiring, communicate how these can be overcome and continually optimise the process to make sure it is globally scalable
* You'll partner with hiring teams and other People teams (e.g. People Operations), to support various initiatives (e.g. referral programs, talent mapping, salary benchmarking, etc)
* Lead and execute targeted talent acquisition strategies, including campus recruitment programs and weekend hiring drives, to scale the talent pipeline efficiently.


**Qualifications**
 A bit about you:
   

  

* You have a proven track record of hiring exceptional talent while delivering the best partnering experience to candidates and hiring teams for 5\+ years
* You are an adaptable self\-starter \- someone who can use their own initiative to keep things running at pace and won’t wait for answers
* You are good with tooling and make data driven decisions by running reports, building dashboards and implementing new systems
* You are resilient and curious by nature \- you like flipping ambiguity, failures and set\-backs in their head by actually using them as learning opportunities
* You are a creative problem solver. A tricky role won’t get you down. It’s a challenge that just spurs you on to find a new approach and try something new. You're curious and get a real kick out of learning different skills
* You are a confident communicator and influencer, comfortable talking to people of any level, whether it’s in person, on the phone or in writing. You understand how best to adapt your approach to your audience


 Key Attributes
   

  

* Data Driven. You’re able to use data to build narratives and influence change. You can make evidence\-based decisions and you’re able to use data to measure impact
* Flexible \& adaptable. You’re able to switch effectively between tasks and deal with constantly\-changing workload and priorities.
* Initiative. You’re able to identify and seize opportunities. You can work with limited guidance to solve problems.
* Big Thinker. You understand the impact of your work on the success of the company. You’re able to create well thought\-through action plans built around the big picture. You consider others and you’re aware of the impact your work has on other teams. You’re always thinking and planning for scalable and sustainable solutions


 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

 TechDoQuest (TDQ) is a Canadian IT services company delivering solutions architecture, technical staffing, and enterprise systems integration for clients across North America. We're growing our talent acquisition team to support increasing demand for IT talent placements in the US and Canadian markets.

 We are looking for an experienced
 **US IT Recruiter** 
 to source, screen, and place technical talent for our US and Canadian clients. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience with North American IT staffing (contract, contract\-to\-hire, and full\-time placements), understands US work authorization categories (H1B, OPT, GC, USC) and Canadian equivalents (PR, work permits, LMIA basics), and is comfortable working across time zones.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage full\-cycle recruitment for IT roles (developers, QA, DevOps, cloud, data, business analysts, PMs, architects, etc.) for US and Canadian client requirements
* Source candidates through job portals (Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, Indeed), internal ATS/database, referrals, and Boolean/X\-ray search techniques
* Screen resumes and conduct initial phone/video interviews to assess technical fit, communication skills, rate/salary expectations, and work authorization status

* Build and maintain a strong bench of pre\-vetted candidates for recurring skill sets
* Collaborate with account managers/bench sales team on requirement prioritization

* Hands\-on experience with job boards and sourcing tools (Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, Indeed, ZipRecruiter)
* Experience with ATS platforms (Bullhorn, JobDiva, Ceipal, or similar)
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills — client\- and candidate\-facing role
* Ability to work in overlapping US/Canada time zones (EST/CST/PST)
* Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience



**Preferred / Nice to Have** 



* Experience recruiting for niche/high\-demand skills (cloud — AWS/Azure/GCP, data engineering, cybersecurity, ERP)
* Prior experience working with a staffing/IT services firm serving North American clients
* Exposure to bench sales coordination
* Experience using AI\-assisted sourcing/recruiting tools



**What TDQ Offers** 



* Opportunity to work directly with North American clients and technical teams
* Growth path into senior recruiter / team lead roles
* Performance\-based incentives tied to placements

 We believe that Talent Acquisition at scale only works when the processes, systems and data behind it are dependable. That takes a particular kind of person: someone who sees a messy process and wants to fix it, who cares whether the numbers are right, and who understands that behind every KPI is a recruiter trying to do their job well.

* Continuous improvement. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, remove inefficiencies and strengthen reporting, working with HR, IT and external vendors to implement new solutions.
* Global projects. Support transformation initiatives including system implementations, process redesign and market rollouts.
* Executive recruitment coordination. We’ll be straight with you: this part sits apart from the rest of the role. You’ll partner with our Global Executive Recruitment Manager on the coordination behind executive hiring: scheduling, candidate communications, keeping complex searches moving. We’re a small global team and we pull together when it counts, so this comes with the territory. It also comes with an invitation: bring your technology skills to it and find the smarter way to run it.


**We're Looking For Someone Who**
* Has proven experience in Talent Acquisition operations within a complex, global organization.

 You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy \- and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.

**About The Hosteller** 




  





 We opened our first hostel in 2015 on a simple bet: that where you stay should be the reason you meet people, not just somewhere to sleep. 11 years on, we operate 75\+ hostels across India. Working here looks like that too. Teams are small, decisions are close to the ground, and what you build shows up in a real property with real guests within weeks. You will work across functions, you will own things earlier than you expected and be trusted to fix what you find broken.
 



  





**Role overview** 




  





 Purely hiring, coordinating and closing: the manager supplies the funnel, the executive supports the paperwork and your role converts candidates into joiners. Roles to hire on: general managers, front office managers/executive/associates, cafe managers/asst. managers, multi\-skilled technicians, security guards, etc.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Own closure. Screening, coordinating, negotiating and closing, worked from a funnel the manager keeps supplied
* Run the mandatory telephonic screening on every front office role, including PMS or POS proficiency and a guest escalation example
* Independently own multiple roles across hostels, prioritise by business urgency, and ensure no role ages beyond its TAT
* Hold a ready\-to\-hire backup for every active role, and three to five strong candidates in play on anything critical
* Coordinate the panel: slots, reminders and same\-day feedback. Chase the decision rather than waiting for it.
* Align hiring managers on JD clarity, candidate expectations and feedback timelines, and push back constructively when a requirement is unclear or unrealistic
* Handle negotiation within band on pay, role clarity and location, and escalate anything above band before committing to a candidate
* Own the candidate relationship from first conversation to reporting, because the drop between offer and joining is charged to this seat
* Sell the vision. Absolute belief in the culture and the growth path is what closes a candidate holding a competing offer at a similar number.
* Direct the executive on documentation, verification, paperwork and reporting, and tell the manager the moment the funnel runs thin.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* MBA or PGDM in HR or a related field
* Minimum 3 years in talent acquisition, including hospitality, restaurants, etc.
* Strong assessment of spoken communication
* A closer: comfortable negotiating, chasing decisions \& holding a candidate through notice
* Absolute belief in the company's vision and culture, and the ability to sell it

title: Recruiter
description:
About Lokal :
   

  

 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the
   

  

 internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back
   

  

 every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually,
   

  

 something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in
   

  

 one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave
   

  

 us the insight \- when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how
   

  

 Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved.
   

  

**We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:**
* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)


**Advisory Services** 
 \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight\+ AI. When
   

  

 someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
   

  

 This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.
   

  

**We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.**
 We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and
   

  

 3one4 Capital
   

  

**Requirements**
**Role Overview**
 As a Recruiter at Lokal, you will own the complete hiring lifecycle — from sourcing and screening to stakeholder
   

  

 management and offer closures. The role requires strong execution capability, urgency, structured communication, and
   

  

 the ability to hire across both volume and niche mandates.
   

  

 You will work closely with hiring managers across functions and play a critical role in scaling teams efficiently.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for Lateral \& Niche hiring mandates
* Source candidates through job portals, referrals, LinkedIn, social media, and alternate channels
* Screen and evaluate candidates based on role fit, communication, intent, and culture alignment
* Coordinate interviews and drive fast turnaround times across hiring stages
* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and hiring priorities

 compensation benchmarks, and sourcing strategies for critical roles.
   

  

* Ensure hiring mandates and timelines are consistently followed during MOM discussions, hiring sync\-ups, and stakeholder


 reviews.
   

  

* Track progress against hiring goals, highlight bottlenecks proactively, and drive timely closures through regular


 coordination with hiring managers and interview panels.
   

  

* Maintain accountability across stakeholders by documenting action items, follow\-ups, and hiring updates during


 recruitment sync meetings.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 2 \- 4 years of experience in recruitment/talent acquisition
* Experience in handling lateral and Niche hiring across multiple roles
* Strong sourcing and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment with aggressive hiring targets
* Good communication and candidate engagement skills
* Strong ownership mindset and execution focus
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, ATS tools, and hiring dashboards
* Prior experience in startup hiring is a plus


**Why Join Us?**
* Opportunity to work directly with high\-growth business teams
* Fast learning environment with high ownership
* Exposure to diverse hiring mandates and scaling challenges

* Chance to contribute to process automation and recruitment innovation

title: Associate Recruiter (Non-Tech)
description:
**ABOUT NEO** 




 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia** 
 — Co\-Founder of
 **Zeta** 
 ,
 **Radix** 
 , and
 **Titan** 
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* **Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* **Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* **Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* **Drive** 
 — AI\-native repository, where humans and agents can co\-work on files.
* **Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 As a Non\-Tech Recruiter at Neo, you'll own full\-cycle hiring across Product, Marketing, and Support the functions that turn a great product into a great company. You'll treat AI the way a great recruiter treats a strong referral network: as leverage. You'll run sourcing, drafting, ranking, and coordination through AI so your human hours go where they actually matter — reading people, selling the mission, and making judgment calls a model can't. If you still copy\-paste the same outreach fifty times by hand, this role will feel like a downgrade. If that sentence made you wince, we should talk.
 



 You'll partner closely with function leaders and hiring managers, keep candidates genuinely well\-treated end to end, close offers that stick, and help build the AI\-native recruiting motion itself — the prompts, the playbooks, and the shared skills that make the whole Talent team faster.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Own the full cycle. Take mandates across Product, Marketing, and Support from intake to signed offer — sourcing, screening, interview management, offer, and close — with hiring managers as true partners, not ticket\-takers.
* Recruit with AI in the loop. Use AI to source, draft outreach, summarize screens, rank pipelines, and prep interview kits — then apply the human judgment that decides who actually moves forward.
* Range across role profiles. Switch between a product manager, a performance marketer, and a support lead without losing rigor — each function has its own signal.
* Build the machine, not just the hires. Turn what works into reusable prompts, playbooks, and skills the rest of the Talent team can run.
* Protect the candidate experience. Fast, honest, respectful — every candidate should leave the process thinking well of Neo, offer or not.
* Run on data. Track funnel health, spot where pipelines leak, and course\-correct with numbers rather than vibes.
* Close. Sell the mission to candidates who could go anywhere, navigate competing offers, and get the right people to say yes.



  





**SKILLS** 



* A recruiter's instinct for people — you can read a candidate, sell a vision, and tell signal from polish.
* Genuine fluency with AI tools, and the curiosity to push them past the defaults. You experiment, you iterate on prompts, you don't wait for a manual.
* Sharp written and verbal communication — outreach people actually reply to.
* Strong stakeholder partnership — you build trusted relationships with hiring managers, align early on what great looks like, and can offer a candid point of view while keeping the collaboration positive.
* Comfort with ambiguity and speed — startup pace is a feature for you, not a bug.
* Sound judgment on where automation ends and a human conversation has to begin.
* High standards and higher ownership — you close roles, you don't just work them.



  





**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS** 



* 3\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience, with hands\-on hiring across Product, Marketing, and Support functions.
* A track record of closing hard\-to\-fill non\-tech roles at both volume and quality.
* Experience recruiting for product\-based companies (essential) — you understand how these functions operate inside a product org.
* Demonstrated use of AI or automation to make your own work faster (bonus points if you can show us your favorite workflow).
* A bias for action, a low tolerance for busywork, and a real appetite for the volume of hiring ahead.

title: Hiring for Field RF Test
description:
Field Test Engineer – RF / Anti\-Drone / GNSS Systems

Department Engineering / Testing \& Field Operations

Designation Field Test Engineer

Experience 3–8 Years

Location Field / Customer Sites / Project Locations

Employment Type Full\-Time

Reporting To Manager – Testing / Engineering

1\. Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Field Test Engineer with hands\-on experience in RF detection, RF jamming, Anti\-

Drone systems, GNSS jamming/detection systems, RF Detectors and electronic\-warfare\-related equipment.

The candidate will be responsible for installation, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, field trials, performance

evaluation and customer\-site support of RF\-based Anti\-Drone, GNSS Jammer, RF Detector and related systems.

The role involves extensive travel to customer locations, operational sites, test ranges and field\-trial locations for

installation, acceptance testing, demonstrations, troubleshooting and evaluation of new equipment.

2\. Key Responsibilities

Installation \& Commissioning

* Install and commission RF Anti\-Drone Jammers, GNSS Jammers, RF Detectors, RF Surveillance and associated

systems at customer and field locations.

* Install RF equipment, antennas, RF cables, power supplies, control units and communication interfaces.
* Verify system configuration, antenna connections, grounding, power supply and communication links.
* Perform system\-level checks after installation and ensure equipment is ready for operation.

Field Testing \& Trials

* Conduct field testing and performance evaluation of RF detection and jamming systems.
* Participate in customer demonstrations, qualification trials, acceptance tests and operational field trials.
* Execute approved test plans and customer requirements.
* Perform RF measurements and verify frequency coverage, signal strength, detection range, jamming effectiveness

and system response.

* Record test results, observations and anomalies and prepare field\-test reports.

Troubleshooting \& Maintenance

* Diagnose and troubleshoot RF systems, antennas, RF cables, power supplies, communication interfaces and control

software.

* Identify hardware, RF and system\-level faults during field deployment.
* Perform fault isolation and coordinate with design, production and engineering teams for corrective action.
* Carry out system reconfiguration, calibration and replacement of faulty modules where required.

Customer \& Field Support

* Travel to customer locations, defence establishments, test ranges and field locations as required.
* Support customer demonstrations and technical presentations during field trials.
* Interact with customer engineering, technical and operational teams.
* Provide on\-site technical support during deployment and operational trials.

New Product Testing

* Participate in testing and evaluation of new RF / Anti\-Drone / GNSS / Detection and Jamming equipment.
* Develop and execute test procedures for new equipment.
* Verify equipment functionality against specifications and requirements.
* Identify design issues and field\-level problems and provide feedback to R\&D/product\-development teams.

3\. Required Technical Skills

RF Engineering

* Strong understanding of RF fundamentals and wireless communication systems.
* Knowledge of RF propagation, antennas, transmission lines and RF link budgets.
* Understanding of frequency, bandwidth, modulation, power levels, sensitivity, noise and interference.
* Ability to interpret RF measurements and analyse spectrum plots.

RF Detection

* Practical knowledge of RF signal detection, spectrum monitoring, RF signal identification, direction\-finding concepts,

signal\-strength measurement, RF interference analysis and detection\-range testing.

RF Jamming

* Knowledge of RF jamming principles, GNSS jamming concepts, RF interference/denial, jamming\-effectiveness

evaluation, frequency coverage, power requirements and antenna systems.

Anti\-Drone / Counter\-UAS

* Understanding of RF\-based drone detection and identification, RF jamming/mitigation, GNSS\-based drone navigation

concepts and Counter\-UAS system architecture.

4\. Test Equipment Knowledge

Candidates should be comfortable operating or learning to operate: Spectrum Analyzer, RF Signal Generator, RF

Power Meter, Vector Network Analyzer (VNA), Oscilloscope, Multimeter, Frequency Counter, VSWR/Return Loss

Measurement Equipment, RF Attenuators, Couplers, Loads, Directional Antennas, RF Cables and Connectors.

5\. Qualification

Essential: B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Electronics Engineering, RF/Microwave

Engineering, Telecommunications or Electrical \& Electronics Engineering.

Preferred: Experience in Defence Electronics, RF Systems, Electronic Warfare, Counter\-UAS, RF Surveillance,

Spectrum Monitoring, RF Detection or Jamming Systems.

6\. Experience

Preferred Experience: 3–8 Years.

Candidates with hands\-on experience in RF Detection Systems, RF Jamming Systems, Anti\-Drone / Counter\-UAS

Systems, GNSS Detection/Jamming Systems, RF Surveillance, Electronic Warfare Systems, Spectrum Monitoring, RF

Communication Systems, Defence Electronics, RF Test \& Measurement, or Antenna Testing and RF Integration will be

strongly preferred.

Candidates who have participated in field trials, customer installations and troubleshooting of RF systems will be given

preference over candidates with only theoretical RF knowledge.

7\. Behavioural \& Field Skills

* Strong hands\-on troubleshooting ability.
* Ability to work independently at customer and field locations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work under pressure during field trials and demonstrations.
* Good communication and customer\-interaction skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India and, if required, internationally.
* Ability to prepare clear and technically accurate test reports.
* Ability to coordinate with R\&D, production, quality and project teams.
* Good documentation and reporting discipline.

8\. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with RF detection and/or jamming equipment and understand

how such systems behave in real\-world environments.

Preference will be given to candidates who have previously worked on: RF Detector → RF Detection → Signal Analysis

→ RF Jamming → GNSS Jamming → Anti\-Drone / Counter\-UAS → Field Trials → Customer Installation →

Troubleshooting.

Candidates should be capable of independently carrying out a site visit, understanding the RF environment, setting up

test equipment, conducting tests, identifying faults and reporting results to the engineering team.

9\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Successful installation and commissioning of field systems.
* Timely completion of field trials and customer demonstrations.
* Accuracy and completeness of test reports.
* Effective troubleshooting and reduction of repeat field failures.
* Successful resolution of customer\-site technical issues.
* Compliance with approved test procedures and safety requirements.
* Quality of technical feedback provided to R\&D and engineering teams.
* Customer satisfaction during installation and field support.

title: Business Development Lead: Defence & Intelligence(Veterans Hiring)
description:
**About Auric AI** 




 Auric AI helps the people who defend the country make faster, sharper decisions. We take the flood of data they collect across every source and turn it into answers they can act on. Behind it is a research\-first team working on some of the hardest problems in AI, from intelligence fusion to computer vision to signals analysis, built in India for Indian needs. We are now building out the commercial side from the ground up.
 



**Who This Is For** 




 Officers released on completion of Short Service Commission tenure, or who have taken premature retirement, with roughly 8 to 15 years of service behind them. You are early in your second innings, still building, and looking for a role where the outcome sits squarely on you.
 



**The Role** 




 You will own everything from lead to conversion. We have real interest across the services and need someone to turn it into trials, evaluations, and orders. You will be on the ground constantly, setting up demonstrations, following up without being told to, and keeping every opportunity alive through long cycles until it closes. You will work directly with the founder and carry customer reality straight back into the product.
 



**This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. There are no direct reports. You will be carrying the kit, making the calls, running the demos, and doing your own follow\-ups.** 




**What You Will Own** 



* The full pipeline across the Army, Navy, Air Force, and intelligence agencies. You will nurture existing leads and relentlessly generate new ones.
* Reaching out to prospective users proactively and getting the product in front of them, again and again.
* Running and coordinating live demonstrations yourself, then following up hard and staying on it until there is a decision.
* Navigating induction and procurement pathways such as iDEX, user trials, evaluations, and DAP routes, as a builder who learns the system rather than a fixer who games it.
* Being the bridge between users and our technical team, carrying requirements in and demo feedback back.
* Representing Auric AI at exhibitions, service establishments, and wherever our users are.
* Where your background allows, sharpening our use cases against how operations actually run.



**Who You Are** 



* An ex\-Armed Forces officer with roughly 8 to 15 years of service, released on completion of SSC tenure or through premature retirement.
* Relentless and thick\-skinned. You take rejection on the chin, stay optimistic, and pursue a lead for months without losing steam.
* Someone who moves fast, works without a support structure, and is comfortable being the one who does the work rather than directing it.
* A strong communicator with real presence, credible in front of senior serving officers.
* Genuinely comfortable with technology and able to explain a sophisticated product simply.
* Ready to travel extensively and live out of a bag when the pipeline demands it.



**A Big Plus** 



* A background in military intelligence or the Intelligence Corps, or exposure to intelligence, ISR, or surveillance work. This lets you double as a domain expert, pressure\-test the product, and carry real credibility into the room.



**Why This Is Worth It** 



* You take a genuinely new capability to the people who need it, and you see the impact directly.
* Direct access to the founder and a serious technical team, working on problems that matter.
* Real ownership and real stakes, at a stage where what you build shapes the company.

title: Talent Acquisition & Founder's Office
description:
Okay Done is a digital marketing agency with a diverse clientele, such as Royal Challengers Bengaluru, OnePlus, VRL, Google, Bengaluru City Police, Heineken, and Health Care Global to name a few. We work across various industries, including sports, consumer, hospitality, luxury, F\&B, real estate and D2C.
 



  





**Overview** 




 Location:
 **Bengaluru** 
  \| Type:
 **Full\-time, onsite** 
 \| Experience:
 **1 to 2 years** 




  





**Read This First** 




 If things slip through your fingers, this role is not for you.
 



  





 That is the single hardest filter we have, and we are not going to be shy about it. In one day you will move between a candidate you are chasing, a letter that has to go out, a calendar that keeps changing, and a vendor waiting on an answer. Four different jobs before lunch.
 



  





 Most people can do any one of those well. Very few can do all four in the same day without dropping one. The ones who drop one usually do not notice they dropped it, which is the actual problem.
 



  





 If you are the person who remembers the thing everyone else forgot, keep reading.
 



  





**The Role, Honestly** 




 Three jobs in one, and all three are apprenticeships.
 



  





**Talent acquisition:** 
 You find people. Then you learn how we pick them, because how we hire is genuinely different from how most agencies do it, and it is the reason the work here is good. You will be taught this directly by the Partner and the Managing Partner. Not from a course, not from a recruitment SOP. From sitting in on the calls and then being handed the next one.
 



  





**Founder's office:** 
 You sit beside the people running this company. The calendar, the follow ups, the things that need chasing, the decisions that need turning into action. You will see how the business is actually run, from the seat where it happens.
 



  





**HR:** 
 The paperwork, the sheets, the attendance, the onboarding. Unglamorous, and the reason everything else works.
 



  





 Do all three well and you will understand how a company is staffed and run within a year. Most people take five.
 



  





**What You Will Actually Do** 




 • Scout talent. Hunt across LinkedIn, portfolios, Instagram, campuses, referrals, and places nobody else is looking. Build pipelines before we need them, not after. A good scout has three names ready the day a role opens.
 



 • Learn our way of hiring. Sit in on screening calls with the Partner and the Managing Partner. Watch what they ask and understand why. Then start running first rounds yourself.
 



 • Run the hiring process end to end. Job posts, applications, shortlists, scheduling, feedback, closing the loop with everyone. Candidates should never be left wondering where they stand.
 



 • Run the Managing Partner's calendar. Guard it, sequence it, protect it. Know what deserves an hour and what deserves fifteen minutes. Confirm, remind, reschedule, and never let a meeting fall through because nobody chased it.
 



 • Own the paperwork. Offer letters, appointment letters, onboarding documents, exit formalities. Accurate, on time, no typos in someone's name or their number.
 



 • Keep the sheets clean. Attendance, leave, candidate trackers, employee records. If a sheet is out of date, that is on you and only you.
 



 • Onboard people properly. First day sorted, laptop sorted, accounts sorted, introductions made. Nobody's first impression of this place should be confusion.
 



 • A bit of internal ops. Not content ops, we already have someone excellent on that. This is the managerial side. Vendor coordination, office and admin running, internal approvals, keeping small processes from becoming big problems. It is a slice of the job, not the job.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




 • You are frighteningly organized. Chaos walks in, order walks out.
 



 • You read people quickly. You will be the first human every candidate speaks to. Within one call you should have a real opinion on whether they are worth the founders' time.
 



 • You speak and write well. How you sound is how this company looks to everyone applying to it.
 



 • You are not a pushover. You will have to tell a senior person their meeting is moving, or that their document is late. You do it politely, firmly, every time.
 



 • You notice details. Wrong date on a letter, a name spelled two ways, a mismatch between two sheets. You catch it before anyone else does.
 



 • You close loops. You do not leave a message unanswered or a task half done because nobody followed up. You are the follow up.
 



 • You are hungry, coachable, and allergic to mediocrity.
 



  





**About Experience** 




 We are looking for 1 to 2 years of work experience. Not zero, because you should already know what a workplace feels like and how to talk to people senior to you. Not ten, because this is a role you grow into and we would rather build the habits with you than undo someone else's.
 



  





 What that experience was in matters far less. HR, recruitment, sales, operations, hospitality, teaching, a family business, something else entirely. We will teach you recruitment, documentation, and how this company runs. What we cannot teach is how you carry yourself, whether you notice things, and how badly you want it.
 



  





**What You Get** 




 • Direct mentorship from the Partner and the Managing Partner. You learn hiring, judgement, and operations from the people doing it, not teaching it.
 



 • A seat where you see everything. Strategy, hiring, decisions. Most people at your stage see none of it.
 



 • Real ownership from month one. Your own roles to fill, your own systems to build. No fetching coffee.
 



 • Weekends that are actually yours. Weekdays are intense and we will not pretend otherwise. When Friday ends, you shut off completely. No calls, no messages, no guilt.
 



 • A career accelerator. People who do this role well become HR leads, chiefs of staff, and operators. Not assistants.

 We help organisations find the skills and solutions to reach their goals and assist talented professionals to power their unique potential.

**About The Job**
 We are seeking an experienced RPO Resourcing Partner to join our team in an exciting client partnership role based at our GBS in Hyderabad. This position requires deep expertise in end to end services for recruitment, particularly Front Office \& back office roles, and a comprehensive understanding of the existing talent market. You'll be embedded with our global Banking client, delivering end\-to\-end recruitment solutions while working collaboratively with our RPO team and client stakeholders

* Meet regularly with line managers to discuss new opportunities and develop tailored resourcing strategies

**End\-to\-End Recruitment Management**
* Manage complete recruitment lifecycle from hiring manager intake briefings through to offer acceptance

* Specialize in Front Office recruitment across Investment Banking, Equities, and Fixed Income divisions

**Recruitment Process Management**

**Candidate Management**
* Professionally and effectively manage the recruitment process from beginning to end
* Source, select, and assess candidate skills and experiences, career goals, and suitability for client roles

* Organize and coordinate interviews, fully briefing candidates
* Continuously monitor and update candidate database to ensure accuracy and availability

**Client Engagement \& Partnership**
* Build and maintain trusted, long\-term relationships with client stakeholders as an embedded partner

* Manage complete interview process including candidate screening, interview coordination, feedback, and remuneration package negotiations


**Process and Procedures**
* Ensure strict compliance with Service Level Agreements
* Produce regular, meaningful reports for both client stakeholders and senior management team
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators and recruitment metrics
* Continuously improve processes based on client feedback and industry best practices


**Essential Requirements**
**What You Will Bring**
* 3\-5 years of professional recruitment experience with strong focus on financial services
* Proven expertise in Front Office recruitment including Investment Banking, Equities, and Fixed Income roles
* Deep knowledge of the global financial services market including key players, compensation benchmarks, and talent trends
* Experience with applicant tracking systems and end\-to\-end recruitment process management
* RPO or embedded recruitment experience preferred
* Vendor management experience with ability to coordinate multiple recruitment agencies
* Strong stakeholder management skills for building relationships with line managers at all levels


**Core Competencies**
* Organized and driven approach with excellent attention to detail
* Excellent team player with ability to collaborate effectively across APAC time zones
* Strong analytical skills for producing meaningful reports and market intelligence
* Exceptional communication skills for interfacing between multiple stakeholder groups


**Additional Qualifications**
* Professional recruitment certifications advantageous
* Fluency in English required; additional Indian languages beneficial
* Strong network within financial services community preferred
* Proficiency in recruitment metrics and reporting tools


**Benefits**
* A unique opportunity to drive projects such as Employer Branding, Talent pipelining, Recruitment Innovation, Candidate Experience
* A track record of high performance and an ability to deliver excellent results consistently is key. In return for your hard work, you'll be offered a competitive top salary and benefits package with bonuses/commission and fantastic incentives programme
* Private medical insurance
* A fantastic training and development programme
* Volunteer time off
* The opportunity to partake / qualify for our Global incentive weekend
* Employee wellbeing through various programmes
* You'll have plenty of opportunities to progress your career, both in your country and other locations around the world. That's the benefit of working for a large global organisation. One that is at the forefront of recruitment innovation, and a specialist in RPO and MSP

 Pega’s Talent Advisory Team provides timely, accurate, and straightforward advice on people strategies, organizational development, talent management, employee issues, local labor laws, compliance, and corporate directives.

 Pega’s vision is to change how the world builds software, and while our technology and business encompass what we do, our culture drives how we get the job done. As a Talent Advisory Partner, you will be supporting and coaching our managers to drive a high\-performance culture. If you are passionate about supporting and helping others and driving organization success through HR excellence, we encourage you to apply. This is a hybrid role, with 2\-3 days in\-office.
   

  

 At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.
   

  

 We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel for ad hoc reporting.

You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.

* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

description:
For the kind of soul who finds energy in finding people, not just helping them get the job done.
 



 Recruiting is one of those crafts where most people are bad, very few are great, and the great ones quietly run the most important function in any growing company. Without the right people walking in, nothing else scales. Without speed, the right people walk out before they walk in.
 



 We are not great at this yet. We get hundreds of applicants per role, the leadership reviews most of them, and good candidates slip through because nobody got back to them in time. That is the gap this role is built to close.
 



  





**About The Test Tribe** 




 We are the world's largest Software Testing community turned Workforce Development Startup. 170K\+ members. 130\+ countries. 45\+ global chapters. Close to 1000 events done so far, including 30\+ large\-scale global conferences. We hold a high quality bar and we keep raising it. Products, services, flagship events, all of it.
 



 About the Role
 



 This is a Talent Acquisition internship role inside the Founder's Office.
 



 You work directly with the founder and leadership on every open role at TTT. Right now that means Business Development, Community, Founder's Office, and Operations hires. Tomorrow it will mean more.
 



 If you want a role that compresses 2 years of recruiting experience and learning into 3\-6 months, this is that role. And you can ask this to quite a few interns who walked the same path at TTT.
 



 Stipend: ₹10,000 to ₹20,000/month, based on what you bring to the table readily.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Source candidates daily across LinkedIn, Apollo, Internshala, Naukri, and college networks for 3 to 5 open roles at any time
* Run first\-pass screens on every applicant. Tag Good Fit, Maybe, Not a Fit. Surface the top 5 to 10 per role to the founder, weekly
* Own outbound cold emails, calls to candidates we want, not just inbound applicants we got
* Manage candidate communication end\-to\-end. Scheduling, follow\-ups, no\-show recovery, post\-interview feedback
* Own the recruiting tracker. One clean funnel dashboard per role, weekly Monday report
* Run employer branding lite. Careers page hygiene, candidate testimonial posts, founder\-led hiring posts on LinkedIn

title: Talent Sourcing Specialist – IT/Tech
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 We are looking for a driven and intellectually curious Talent Sourcing Specialist to join BCG's APAC
   

  

 Talent Acquisition team in Gurugram. In this role, you will lead proactive sourcing efforts for highpriority technology positions across India, with a strong focus on emerging and in\-demand tech skill
   

  

 areas including Generative AI, Digital Product Management, Software Engineering, and other
   

  

 cutting\-edge technology disciplines.
   

  

 Working in close partnership with Recruiters and Hiring Managers, you will own the end\-to\-end
   

  

 sourcing strategy — from market mapping and talent intelligence to candidate engagement and
   

  

 pipeline development — ensuring BCG continues to attract world\-class technology talent.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead proactive sourcing for critical technology roles across BCG India, spanning Generative AI,


 Digital Product, Full\-Stack Engineering, Data Science, Cloud \& Infrastructure, and Platform
   

  

 Engineering.
   

  

* Partner closely with Hiring Managers and Recruiters to define role requirements, ideal


 candidate profiles, and tailored sourcing strategies for each position.
   

  

* Identify and engage both active and passive talent through direct outreach, social media


 platforms (LinkedIn, GitHub, Kaggle), talent communities, and professional networks.
   

  

* Develop and execute market mapping and talent intelligence exercises to provide data\-driven


 insights on talent availability, competitor hiring trends, and compensation benchmarks.
   

  

* Build and manage robust, future\-ready talent pipelines to support both immediate hiring


 needs and long\-term workforce planning.
   

  

* Articulate and champion the BCG employee value proposition compellingly across all candidate


 interactions, networking events, and brand\-building activities.
   

  

* Conduct initial screening and high\-level assessment of candidates' technical knowledge, skills,


 and cultural fit.
   

  

* Maintain accurate, real\-time tracking of candidate pipelines within the Applicant Tracking


 System (ATS) and provide regular pipeline health reports to stakeholders.
   

  

 TECHNOLOGY SKILL AREAS YOU'LL SOURCE FOR
   

  

 You will build deep expertise in sourcing talent across BCG's key technology hiring domains,
   

  

**Including**
* Generative AI \& Large Language Models (LLMs) — Prompt Engineers, AI/ML Researchers,


 Applied AI Scientists
   

  

* Digital Product Management — Product Managers, Product Owners, Agile Delivery Leads
* Software Engineering — Full\-Stack, Backend, Frontend, Mobile (iOS/Android)
* Data \& Analytics — Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers
* Cloud \& DevOps — Cloud Architects, Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), DevOps/Platform


 Engineers
   

  

* Cybersecurity \& Enterprise Technology — Security Engineers, ERP Specialists, IT Architects


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 2–4\+ years of talent acquisition or sourcing experience, with a strong track record in tech


 hiring — agency or in\-house experience in professional services or consulting is a plus.
   

  

* Proven expertise in sourcing for technology roles — ideally including GenAI, Digital Product, or


 Engineering talent.
   

  

* Proficiency with modern sourcing tools and platforms: LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Boolean


 search, talent intelligence tools (e.g., HireEZ, SeekOut).
   

  

* Experience conducting talent mapping, competitor analysis, and market benchmarking


 exercises.
   

  

* Strong candidate assessment skills with experience in competency/behavioural\-based


 screening.
   

  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to craft compelling outreach and


 articulate complex roles clearly.
   

  

* High degree of organisation and the ability to manage multiple concurrent searches without


 compromising quality.
   

  

* Creative problem\-solver who can adapt sourcing strategies when conventional approaches


 don't yield results.
   

  

* Bachelor's degree with strong academic achievement.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 BCG's Global Recruiting team is a high\-performing, collaborative function that partners directly with
   

  

 business units to attract and select exceptional talent across every region. You will work alongside
   

  

 Recruiters, Hiring Managers, HR Business Partners, and regional Talent Acquisition leads — with
   

  

 direct exposure to BCG's technology and digital transformation agenda
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
